units.en: Music 16

units.zh: 〈（鼓吹下）〉
units.en: (Drumming and Blowing: Lower)
units.literal: (Drumming and Blowing: Lower)

units.zh: ○高宗郊祀大禮五首《導引》
units.en: ○ Five pieces for Emperor Gaozong's suburban sacrifice: 《Processional》
units.literal: ○ Five pieces for Emperor Gaozong's suburban sacrifice great rite: 《Processional》

units.zh: 聖皇巡狩，清蹕駐三吳，十世嗣瑤圖。
units.en: The sacred emperor makes his tour; the cleared procession halts in the Three Wus, where the jade lineage of ten reigns is secured.
units.literal: The sage emperor tours on inspection; the cleared road halts in the Three Wus; the jade chart of succession for ten generations.

units.zh: 邊塵不動幹戈戢，文德溥天敷。
units.en: Along the borders dust lies still and arms are laid down, while civil virtue spreads across the realm.
units.literal: Border dust does not stir; weapons and armor are stilled; civil virtue spreads over heaven.

units.zh: 灰飛緹室氣潛噓，郊見紫壇初。
units.en: Ash rises as breath stirs in the reed chamber; the first suburban audience takes place at the purple altar.
units.literal: Ash flies; the reed chamber's qi breathes in secret; the first suburban audience at the purple altar.

units.zh: 歸來赦令樓前下，喜氣溢寰區。
units.en: Upon his return the amnesty is proclaimed before the palace gate, and joy floods every corner of the realm.
units.literal: Upon return the amnesty edict is issued before the tower; joyous qi overflows the whole realm.

units.zh: 《六州》
units.en: Six Prefectures
units.literal: 《Six Prefectures》

units.zh: 雙鳳落，佳氣藹龍山。
units.en: Twin phoenixes alight, and auspicious vapors mantle Dragon Mountain.
units.literal: Two phoenixes descend; auspicious qi gathers over Dragon Mountain.

units.zh: 澄江左，清湖右，日夜海潮翻。
units.en: To the left the river runs clear, to the right the lake lies pure, and day and night the sea tide rolls.
units.literal: Clear river to the left, pure lake to the right; day and night the sea tide turns.

units.zh: 因吉地，卜築圜壇。
units.en: On an auspicious site they divined and built the round altar.
units.literal: On an auspicious site, divination and construction of the round altar.

units.zh: 宏基隆陛級，神位周環。
units.en: A grand foundation rises with lofty steps, and the spirit seats ring the space on every side.
units.literal: Grand foundation, towering steps and terraces; spirit seats all around.

units.zh: 邊陲靜，掛起橐，奠枕海隅安。
units.en: The frontiers lie quiet, quivers are hung away, and peace is settled like a pillow at the ocean's rim.
units.literal: The frontiers are quiet; quivers are hung up; pillows are laid in peace at the sea's edge.

units.zh: 三年親祀，一陽初動，虔修大報，高處紫煙燔。
units.en: After three years he sacrifices in person, as the first yang stirs; devoutly he offers the great report, and purple smoke rises from the lofty altar.
units.literal: After three years he sacrifices in person; the first stir of single yang; devoutly he performs the great report; high above purple smoke burns.

units.zh: 看鳴鑾，鉤陳肅，天仗轉，朔風寒。
units.en: See the imperial carriage resound, Kouchen stand in solemn array, the heavenly guard wheel about, and the north wind bite cold.
units.literal: Behold the sounding imperial carriage; Kouchen is solemn; heavenly regalia turns; the north wind is cold.

units.zh: 孤竹管，雲和瑟，樂奏徹天關。
units.en: Lone bamboo pipes and Yunhe zithers sound, and the music reaches heaven's gate.
units.literal: Lone bamboo pipes, Yunhe zithers; the music plays reaching heaven's gate.

units.zh: 嘉籩薦，玉奠璵璠。
units.en: Fine offerings are presented, and jade is laid with yu and fan stones.
units.literal: Fine dishes are offered; jade is set with yu and fan gems.

units.zh: 奉神歡。
units.en: Joy is offered to the spirits.
units.literal: Offering joy to the spirits.

units.zh: 九霄瑞氣起祥煙，來如風馬然還，留福已滋繁。
units.en: Auspicious vapor rises through the nine heavens; it comes like wind-borne horses and returns, leaving blessings ever more abundant.
units.literal: Auspicious qi in the nine heavens rises as propitious smoke; it comes like wind horses and then returns; blessings left behind already flourish.

units.zh: 回龍馭，升丹闕，布皇澤，春色滿人間。
units.en: The dragon carriage wheels homeward, ascends the vermillion gate, spreads imperial grace, and spring colors fill the world.
units.literal: The dragon carriage turns back; it ascends the vermillion gate; imperial grace is spread; spring colors fill the human world.

units.zh: 《十二時》
units.en: Twelve Hours
units.literal: 《Twelve Hours》

units.zh: 日將旦，陰曀潛消，天宇扇祥飆。
units.en: Dawn nears, the yin gloom quietly lifts, and auspicious winds fan across the sky.
units.literal: The sun is about to dawn; yin gloom secretly disperses; heaven's canopy spreads auspicious wind.

units.zh: 邊陲靜謐，夜熄鳴刁，文教普旁昭。
units.en: The borders lie still, the night gong falls silent, and civil teaching shines far and wide.
units.literal: The border regions are tranquil and still; at night the signal gong is silenced; civil teaching shines universally.

units.zh: 興太學，多士舒翹。
units.en: The Imperial Academy flourishes, and many scholars raise their talents high.
units.literal: The Imperial Academy is established; many scholars extend their excellence.

units.zh: 奉宗祧，新廟榜宸毫，配侑享於郊。
units.en: The ancestral line is honored, the new temple bears the emperor's inscription, and collateral spirits share the suburban feast.
units.literal: The ancestral temple is honored; the new shrine is inscribed with the imperial brush; collateral worship is offered at the suburban rite.

units.zh: 慈寧萬壽，四海仰東朝。
units.en: Long life to Cining Palace; the four seas look to the Eastern Court.
units.literal: Cining longevity for myriad years; the four seas look up to the Eastern Court.

units.zh: 男女正，中壺致《桃夭》。
units.en: Men and women keep their proper places, and the inner quarters fulfill the 《Peach Blossoms》 ideal.
units.literal: Men and women are in proper order; the inner quarters attain the 《Peach Blossoms》 ode.

units.zh: 年屢稔，漕舟銜尾夥，高廩接楹饒。
units.en: Harvest follows harvest, grain boats crowd stem to stern, and high granaries brim from pillar to pillar.
units.literal: Years repeatedly yield harvests; grain boats stem to stern in great numbers; high granaries join pillars in abundance.

units.zh: 廟堂自有擎天一柱，功比漢庭蕭。
units.en: The court has its pillar holding up heaven, with merit to match Xiao He of the Han.
units.literal: The court temple has its own pillar holding up heaven; merit comparable to Xiao of the Han court.

units.zh: 多少群工同德，俊乂旁招。
units.en: Countless ministers share one virtue, and outstanding men are gathered from every quarter.
units.literal: How many ministers share one virtue; outstanding men are gathered from all sides.

units.zh: 吉祥諸福集，燮理四時調。
units.en: Auspicious blessings gather, and the four seasons are harmoniously tuned.
units.literal: Auspicious blessings all gather; the four seasons are harmonized and tuned.

units.zh: 三年郊見，六變奏《鹹》、《韶》。
units.en: After three years comes the suburban audience, with six changes performing the 《Xian》 and 《Shao》.
units.literal: After three years the suburban audience; six changes perform the 《Xian》 and 《Shao》.

units.zh: 望雲霄，降福與唐堯。
units.en: Gazing toward the clouds, blessings descend as they did for Tang Yao.
units.literal: Gazing at clouds and sky; blessings descend like those of Tang Yao.

units.zh: 《奉禋歌》
units.en: Song of the Suburban Sacrifice
units.literal: 《Song of the Suburban Sacrifice》

units.zh: 蒼蒼天色是還非，視下應疑亦若斯。
units.en: Heaven stretches vast and blue—is it real or not? Gazing downward, one might doubt the earth is the same.
units.literal: Vast, vast is heaven's color—is it or is it not? Looking below one should doubt it is likewise.

units.zh: 統元氣，覆無私。
units.en: It governs primal qi and covers all without favor.
units.literal: It governs primal qi and covers all without partiality.

units.zh: 四時寒暑推移，物蕃滋，造化有誰知！
units.en: The four seasons turn through cold and heat, all things flourish—who can fathom creation's hand!
units.literal: The four seasons, cold and heat, advance; things flourish and multiply—who knows the work of creation!

units.zh: 嚴大報，反本始，禮重祀神祗。
units.en: Solemn is the great report, returning to the origin, with rites that honor the spirits in full.
units.literal: Solemn is the great report; return to the origin; rites weightily worship the spirits.

units.zh: 律管灰吹，黃宮動，陽來復，景長時。
units.en: Ash rises in the pitch pipes, the yellow palace note stirs, yang returns, and the days lengthen.
units.literal: Pitch-pipe ash is blown; the yellow palace note moves; yang returns; the days grow long in season.

units.zh: 車陳法駕，仗列黃麾，帝心祗。
units.en: Carriages array the ritual train, yellow banners line the guard, and the emperor's heart is reverent.
units.literal: Carriages array the ritual equipage; regalia ranks yellow banners; the emperor's heart is reverent.

units.zh: 紫霄霽，霜華薄，星爛明垂。
units.en: The purple sky clears, frost lies thin, and stars blaze bright above.
units.literal: The purple heavens clear; frost flowers are thin; stars blaze bright and hang low.

units.zh: 祥煙起，紛敷浮袞冕，六變笙鏞迭奏，一誠幣玉交持。
units.en: Auspicious smoke rises above robes and crowns, pipes and bells play through six changes, and silk and jade are offered with one heart.
units.literal: Auspicious smoke rises, richly spread floating robes and crowns; six changes of pipes and bells play in turn; one sincerity of silk and jade is offered together.

units.zh: 宮漏聲遲，千官顯相多儀。
units.en: The palace water-clock drips slowly as a thousand officials perform the solemn rites.
units.literal: The palace clepsydra sounds slow; a thousand officials in solemn array with many rites.

units.zh: 百神嬉，風馬雲車，來止來綏，誕降純禧。
units.en: The hundred spirits rejoice; wind horses and cloud chariots come and pause, come and soothe, bestowing pure blessing.
units.literal: The hundred spirits rejoice; wind horses and cloud chariots come, halt, come, and soothe; they bestow pure felicity.

units.zh: 受神策，萬年無極，歌頌《昊天成命》周詩。
units.en: Receiving the divine mandate for endless myriad years, they sing the Zhou ode 《Heaven's Grand Mandate》.
units.literal: Receiving the divine mandate, myriad years without limit; singing praise of the 《Heaven's Grand Mandate》 Zhou ode.

units.zh: 《降仙台》
units.en: Descending Immortal Terrace
units.literal: 《Descending Immortal Terrace》

units.zh: 升煙既罷，良夜未曉，天步下神丘。
units.en: The ascending smoke is done, the fine night not yet dawn, and the heavenly steps descend the spirit mound.
units.literal: Ascending smoke is already finished; the fine night is not yet dawn; heavenly steps descend the spirit mound.

units.zh: 鏘鏘鳴玉佩，煒煒照金蓮，杳靄雲裘。
units.en: Jade pendants chime, golden lotus gleams, and cloud robes shimmer through distant mist.
units.literal: Clang clang sound the jade pendants; brilliant brilliant shines the golden lotus; dim mist veils cloud robes.

units.zh: 彩仗初轉，回龍馭，旌旆悠悠。
units.en: Colored regalia wheels about, the dragon carriage turns homeward, and banners stream on the wind.
units.literal: Colored regalia first turns; the dragon carriage returns; banners and flags drift far.

units.zh: 星影疏動與天流，漏盡五更籌。
units.en: Sparse star shadows drift with the sky's turning, and the water-clock runs out at the fifth watch.
units.literal: Star shadows sparse move and flow with heaven; the clepsydra is exhausted at the fifth watch tally.

units.zh: 大明升，東海頭。
units.en: Great brightness rises at the head of the eastern sea.
units.literal: Great brightness rises at the eastern sea's head.

units.zh: 杲杲靈曜，倒影射旗旒。
units.en: Brilliant spirit light flashes, and reflected rays strike the banner tassels.
units.literal: Bright bright spirit radiance; reflected light shoots at banner tassels.

units.zh: 輦路具修，鬱蔥瑞光浮。
units.en: The imperial way is fully arrayed, and lush auspicious light floats above.
units.literal: The imperial path is fully prepared; lush green auspicious light floats.

units.zh: 歸來雙闕，看禦樓，有仙鶴銜書赦囚。
units.en: Returning to the twin towers, they look to the imperial pavilion where an immortal crane bears the edict pardoning prisoners.
units.literal: Returning to the paired towers, viewing the imperial tower, an immortal crane bears documents pardoning prisoners.

units.zh: 萬方喜氣，均祉福，播歌謳。
units.en: Joy fills the ten thousand regions, blessings are shared alike, and songs spread everywhere.
units.literal: Ten thousand regions' joyous qi; equal blessings and fortune; spreading songs and chants.

units.zh: 孝宗郊祀大禮五首《導引》
units.en: Five pieces for Emperor Xiaozong's suburban sacrifice: 《Processional》
units.literal: Five pieces for Emperor Xiaozong's suburban sacrifice great rite: 《Processional》

units.zh: 重華天子，長至奉神虞，九奏會軒、朱。
units.en: The Chonghua Son of Heaven, at the winter solstice honors Spirit Yu, with nine performances at Xuan and Zhu.
units.literal: The Chonghua Son of Heaven, at the winter solstice honors Spirit Yu; nine performances assemble at Xuan and Zhu.

units.zh: 星暉雲潤東方曉，拜貺竹宮初。
units.en: Stars gleam and clouds glisten as the east brightens; the first obeisance and offering are made at Bamboo Palace.
units.literal: Starlight gleams, clouds are moist; eastern dawn; first obeisance and gift at Bamboo Palace.

units.zh: 歸來千乘護皇輿，瑞景集金鋪。
units.en: A thousand chariots escort the imperial carriage homeward, and auspicious scenes gather at the golden gate.
units.literal: Returning, a thousand chariots guard the imperial carriage; auspicious scenes gather at golden settings.

units.zh: 雞竿高唱恩書下，惠露匝中區。
units.en: The cock-pole is raised to proclaim the grace edict, and benevolent dew spreads through the central realm.
units.literal: The cock-pole is raised high proclaiming; the grace edict is issued; benevolent dew encircles the central realm.

units.zh: 《六州》
units.en: Six Prefectures
units.literal: 《Six Prefectures》

units.zh: 嚴更永，今夕是何年？
units.en: The night watches stretch long—what year is this night?
units.literal: Strict night watches are long—what year is this night?

units.zh: 玉衡正，鉤陳粲，天宇起祥煙。
units.en: The jade balance stands true, Kouchen blazes bright, and auspicious smoke rises through the sky.
units.literal: The jade balance is correct; Kouchen is brilliant; heaven's canopy rises with auspicious smoke.

units.zh: 協風應，江海安瀾。
units.en: Harmonious winds answer, and rivers and seas lie calm.
units.literal: Harmonious winds respond; rivers and seas have calm waves.

units.zh: 重規仍疊矩，聖主乘乾。
units.en: Compass and square are layered anew as the sage lord takes his seat upon Qian.
units.literal: Heavy compass still layered square; the sage lord mounts Qian.

units.zh: 舜授禹，盛事光前，稱壽玉卮邊。
units.en: Shun passes the throne to Yu; the grand affair outshines the past, and longevity is toasted beside the jade cup.
units.literal: Shun bestows on Yu; the grand affair illumines the past; toasting longevity beside the jade goblet.

units.zh: 三年親祀，一陽回律，八鄉承宇，觚陛紫為壇。
units.en: After three years he sacrifices in person, yang returns in the pitch pipes, eight villages bear the canopy, and purple goblet steps form the altar.
units.literal: After three years he sacrifices in person; single yang returns in the pitch pipes; eight villages bear the canopy; goblet steps purple for the altar.

units.zh: 仰天顏，齋居寂，誠心肅，禮容專。
units.en: He gazes toward heaven's face, dwells in fasting silence, keeps a solemn heart, and holds his ritual bearing with single focus.
units.literal: Gazing up at heaven's countenance; fasting dwelling is silent; sincere heart solemn; ritual bearing focused.

units.zh: 鳴鍾石，擁輿衛，五輅列駢闐。
units.en: Bells and stones resound, guards surround the carriage, and five chariots crowd the ranks.
units.literal: Bells and stones sound; carriage guard surrounds; five chariots array in crowded ranks.

units.zh: 聽金鑰，虎旅無眠。
units.en: At the sound of golden locks, the tiger guards keep sleepless watch.
units.literal: Listening to golden locks; tiger troops without sleep.

units.zh: 儼千官，須期顯相嘉籩。
units.en: A thousand officials stand in solemn array, awaiting the hour to present fine offerings.
units.literal: Solemn are a thousand officials; awaiting the appointed time to display fine offerings.

units.zh: 一人儉德動天淵，費減大農錢。
units.en: One man's frugal virtue moves heaven's depths, and expenses are cut from the treasury.
units.literal: One man's frugal virtue moves heaven's abyss; expenses are reduced from the Ministry of Revenue.

units.zh: 神示格，宗祧燕，人民悅，祉福正綿綿。
units.en: The spirits show their presence, the ancestral temple feasts, the people rejoice, and blessings flow without end.
units.literal: Spirits show their presence; ancestral temple feasts; people rejoice; blessings and fortune truly unending.

units.zh: 《十二時》
units.en: Twelve Hours
units.literal: 《Twelve Hours》

units.zh: 庭有燎，疊鼓鳴鼉，更問夜如何？
units.en: Fires blaze in the court, layered drums and to-drums sound, and again they ask—how deep has the night grown?
units.literal: The court has blazing fires; layered drums sound the to-drums; again asking how goes the night?

units.zh: 信星彪列，天象森羅。
units.en: Trustworthy stars blaze in rows, and heavenly signs crowd the sky.
units.literal: Trustworthy stars blaze in rows; heavenly signs are dense and arrayed.

units.zh: 虞旦宮，畢觴清廟，漿柘樽犧繼猗那，嘉頌可同科。
units.en: Spirit Yu at dawn in the palace, libation completed at the clear temple, sacrificial brew and zither follow the graceful "Yi Na," and songs of praise rank as one.
units.literal: Spirit Yu at dawn in the palace; completing libation at the clear temple; sacrificial brew and zither continue the graceful "Yi Na"; praise songs can match in merit.

units.zh: 扈聖萬肩摩。
units.en: Escorting the sage, ten thousand shoulders press shoulder to shoulder.
units.literal: Escorting the sage, ten thousand shoulders press close.

units.zh: 飭躬三宿，泰畤縟儀多，丘澤合，嶽瀆從羲、和。
units.en: He disciplines his body three nights; the Tai altar rites are elaborate; mound and marsh unite, and peaks and streams follow Xi and He.
units.literal: Discipline the body three nights; Tai altar elaborate rites are many; mound and marsh unite; peaks and streams follow Xi and He.

units.zh: 神光燭，雲車風馬，芝作蓋，玉為珂。
units.en: Divine light shines forth; cloud chariots and wind horses come; lingzhi forms the canopy, jade the tinklers.
units.literal: Divine light illuminates; cloud chariots and wind horses; lingzhi for canopy; jade for tinklers.

units.zh: 奉瑄成禮，燔柴竣事，休嘉砰隱，丹闕湛恩波。
units.en: The scepter is presented, the rite completed, firewood burned, good omens rumble deep, and grace pours from the vermillion gate.
units.literal: Present the scepter and complete the rite; burn firewood and finish the affair; good omens rumble deep; the vermillion gate pours forth grace waves.

units.zh: 共願乾坤隤祉，邊鄙投戈。
units.en: Together they pray heaven and earth will shower blessings, and the borderlands will cast aside their weapons.
units.literal: Together they wish heaven and earth cascading blessings; borderlands cast aside weapons.

units.zh: 覆盂連瀚海，洗甲挽天河。
units.en: The realm spans the vast sea; armor is washed clean and the Heavenly River drawn back.
units.literal: The covering bowl links to the vast sea; wash armor and draw back the Heavenly River.

units.zh: 欣欣喜色，長遇六龍過。
units.en: Joy lights every face, and the six-dragon carriage passes again and again.
units.literal: Joyful joyful countenance; long encountering six dragons passing.

units.zh: 奏雲和，三脊薦嘉禾。
units.en: Yunhe music is played, and fine grain is offered from the three ridges.
units.literal: Perform Yunhe music; three ridges offer fine grain.

units.zh: 《奉禋歌》
units.en: Song of the Suburban Sacrifice
units.literal: 《Song of the Suburban Sacrifice》

units.zh: 吹葭緹籥氣潛分，雲采宜書壤效珍。
units.en: Reeds are blown in the pitch pipes as qi quietly divides; cloud hues suit inscription, and the earth yields rare treasures.
units.literal: Blow reed on reed pipes; qi secretly divides; cloud hues fitting to inscribe; earth shows rare treasures.

units.zh: 長日至，一陽新。
units.en: The longest day arrives, and the first yang is renewed.
units.literal: The long day arrives; single yang is renewed.

units.zh: 四時玉燭和均，物欣欣，化轉洪鈞。
units.en: The four seasons' jade candles burn in harmony, all things thrive, and transformation turns the great cosmic mold.
units.literal: The four seasons' jade candles are harmonized and balanced; things thrive thriving; transformation turns the great bell-founder's mold.

units.zh: 郊之祭，孤竹管，六變舞《雲門》。
units.en: At the suburban sacrifice, lone bamboo pipes sound and six changes dance the 《Cloud Gate》.
units.literal: At the suburban sacrifice: lone bamboo pipes; six changes dance the 《Cloud Gate》.

units.zh: 自古嚴禋，犧牲具，粢盛潔，豆籩陳。
units.en: Since antiquity the suburban rites have been solemn, victims prepared, grain offerings pure, beans and baskets arrayed.
units.literal: Since antiquity solemn suburban rites; victims complete; grain offerings pure; beans and baskets set out.

units.zh: 袞龍陟降，幣玉紛綸，徹高閽。
units.en: Dragon robes ascend and descend, silk and jade abound, and they pass through the high gate.
units.literal: Dragon robes ascend and descend; silk and jade in profusion; pass through the high gate.

units.zh: 靈之斿，神哉沛，排曆昆侖。
units.en: The spirit's pennants fly; how vast the divine presence, spanning the calendar to Kunlun.
units.literal: The spirit's pennants; spirit how vast; pushing through the calendar to Kunlun.

units.zh: 《九歌》畢，盈郊瞻槱燎，鬥轉參橫將旦，天開地辟如春。
units.en: When the 《Nine Songs》 ends, the suburb fills with watchers of the piled firewood blaze; the Dipper turns, Orion crosses, dawn nears, and heaven and earth open like spring.
units.literal: The 《Nine Songs》 finished; filling the suburb gazing at piled firewood burning; the Dipper turns, Orion crosses, dawn approaching; heaven opens, earth unfolds like spring.

units.zh: 清蹕移輪，闐然鼓吹相聞。
units.en: The cleared road wheels turn, and drumming and blowing resound on every side.
units.literal: The cleared road wheels move; full and loud drumming and blowing are heard one another.

units.zh: 籋祥雲，臚八階，厘逆三神。
units.en: Vaulting through auspicious clouds, eight ranks are proclaimed, and the three spirits are received in order.
units.literal: Vaulting auspicious clouds; proclaim eight ranks; arrange and receive the three spirits.

units.zh: 聖矣吾君！
units.en: Holy is our lord!
units.literal: Holy is our lord!

units.zh: 華封祝，慈宮萬壽，椒掖多男，六合同文。
units.en: Huafeng blessings are offered, long life to the kindly palace, many sons in the inner quarters, and the six harmonies share one script.
units.literal: Huafeng blessings; kindly palace myriad years; pepper quarters many sons; six harmonies same script.

units.zh: 《降仙台》
units.en: Descending Immortal Terrace
units.literal: 《Descending Immortal Terrace》

units.zh: 漏殘柝靜，雞聲遠到，高燎入層霄。
units.en: The water-clock drains low, the night gong falls silent, distant cock-crow sounds, and high flames climb into the layered heavens.
units.literal: The clepsydra runs low, the signal-clapper is still, cock-crow reaches from afar, high flames rise into layered skies.

units.zh: 雲裘蟠瑞靄，天步下嘉壇，旗旆飄搖。
units.en: Cloud robes coil in auspicious mist, heavenly steps descend the fine altar, and banners flutter on the wind.
units.literal: Cloud robes coil with auspicious mist; heavenly steps descend the fine altar; banners and flags flutter and sway.

units.zh: 黃麾列仗貔貅整，氣壓江潮。
units.en: Yellow banners line the guard, fierce troops stand in perfect ranks, their presence overwhelming as the river tide.
units.literal: Yellow banners array regalia; fierce guards stand firm; spirit overwhelms the river tide.

units.zh: 導前從後盛官僚，玉佩間金貂。
units.en: Officials crowd ahead and behind, jade pendants mingling with gold sable badges.
units.literal: Leading before, following after, officials abound; jade pendants interspersed with gold sable.

units.zh: 望扶桑，日漸高，陰霾霜雪，底處不潛消！
units.en: Gazing toward Fusang as the sun climbs higher, gloom and frost and snow melt away everywhere.
units.literal: Gazing at Fusang, the sun gradually rises higher; gloom, frost, and snow—where do they not silently vanish!

units.zh: 輦路祥飆，披拂絳紗袍。
units.en: A blessed gale sweeps the imperial way, fluttering crimson gauze robes.
units.literal: On the imperial path a blessed gale; brushing and fluttering the crimson gauze robes.

units.zh: 雲間端闕仰岧嶢，挾春澤，喜浹黎苗。
units.en: Between the clouds the lofty gate towers steep and high, bearing spring's bounty to soak the people's seedlings with joy.
units.literal: Between clouds the lofty tower gate rises steep and high; bearing spring's bounty, joy soaks the common seedlings.

units.zh: 禮成大慶鼇三抃，受昕朝。
units.en: When the rite is complete, great celebration fills the land—the sea turtle thrice claps as the dawn court is held.
units.literal: The rite accomplished, great celebration; the sea turtle thrice claps; receiving the dawn court audience.

units.zh: 寧宗郊祀大禮四首《六州》
units.en: Four pieces for Emperor Ningzong's suburban sacrifice: 《Six Prefectures》
units.literal: Four pieces for Emperor Ningzong's suburban sacrifice great rite: 《Six Prefectures》

units.zh: 皇撫極，明德貫乾坤。
units.en: The emperor holds the cosmic pole, and bright virtue pierces heaven and earth.
units.literal: The emperor cherishes the pole; bright virtue pierces heaven and earth.

units.zh: 信星列，卿雲爛，輝亙紫微垣。
units.en: Trustworthy stars stand in row, ministerial clouds blaze bright, and radiance spans the Purple Palace enclosure.
units.literal: Trustworthy stars align; ministerial clouds blaze; radiance spans the Purple Palace enclosure.

units.zh: 思報貺，明詔祠官，練時蒐曠典，紫畤觚壇。
units.en: To repay heaven's gift, a bright edict goes to sacrificial officers; the season is chosen to gather ancient rites at the purple goblet altar.
units.literal: Thinking to repay heaven's gift; a bright edict to sacrificial officers; selecting the season to gather ancient rites; the purple altar with goblet steps.

units.zh: 昭孝德，親禦和鑾，振鷺玉珊珊。
units.en: Filial virtue is proclaimed as the emperor personally drives the harmonious carriage, jade pendants chiming like startled herons.
units.literal: Manifesting filial virtue; the emperor personally drives the harmonious carriage; white herons startle, jade chimes clink.

units.zh: 精純謁款，膋蕭爌煬，黃流湛澹，百末布生蘭。
units.en: Pure homage is paid in devotion, fat and aromatic herbs blaze on the flame, yellow sacrificial wine flows deep and still, and a hundred aromatic herbs spread like growing orchids.
units.literal: Pure essence pays devout homage; fat and aromatic herbs blaze and flame; yellow sacrificial wine flows deep and calm; the hundred aromatic herbs spread and grow orchids.

units.zh: 扣天閽，延飛駕，相仿佛，降雲端。
units.en: They knock at heaven's gate, summoning the flying carriage that seems almost to descend from the cloud tops.
units.literal: Knocking at heaven's gate; summoning the flying carriage; nearly alike; descending from the cloud heights.

units.zh: 神光集，嘉響應，靄靄萬衣冠。
units.en: Divine light gathers, auspicious sounds answer, and myriad officials in robes and caps fill the mist.
units.literal: Divine light gathers; auspicious sounds respond; misty mist ten thousand robes and caps.

units.zh: 竣熙事，清曉輕寒。
units.en: The glorious rite is finished in clear dawn with a light chill.
units.literal: The brilliant rite completed; clear dawn with light chill.

units.zh: 恣榮觀，華衣霧縠般般。
units.en: They freely behold the splendor, splendid robes like misty fine silk one after another.
units.literal: Freely viewing glory; splendid robes like misty fine silk, one after another.

units.zh: 乾坤並貺慶君歡，翹首聖恩寬。
units.en: Heaven and earth grant blessings together and rejoice in the lord's joy, all raising heads to the breadth of sage grace.
units.literal: Heaven and earth together grant gifts, celebrating the lord's joy; heads raised, the sage grace is broad.

units.zh: 遵皇極，沛天澤，靈心懌，龜鼎永尊安。
units.en: Following the imperial pole, heaven's bounty overflows; the spirit heart is pleased, and the tortoise and cauldrons stand honored and secure forever.
units.literal: Following the imperial pole; abundant heaven's bounty; the spirit heart is pleased; the tortoise and cauldrons forever honored and secure.

units.zh: 《十二時》
units.en: Twelve Hours
units.literal: 《Twelve Hours》

units.zh: 宵景霽，河漢清夷，曠典講明時。
units.en: Night skies clear, the Milky Way lies pure and calm, and the grand ancient rite is performed at the bright season.
units.literal: Night scenes clear; the Milky Way pure and calm; the grand ancient rite is observed at the bright season.

units.zh: 合祛升侑，孝德爰熙。
units.en: Joint purification rises with secondary offerings, and filial virtue is glorified thereby.
units.literal: Joint purification ascends as secondary offering; filial virtue is thus glorified.

units.zh: 陳稞宮，澹觴太室，來奏天儀。
units.en: The grain palace is arrayed, libations poured in the Grand Chamber, and heaven's ritual is performed.
units.literal: Arraying the grain palace; pouring libations in the Grand Chamber; coming to perform heaven's ritual.

units.zh: 駟蒼螭，玉輅馭蕤綏。
units.en: Four dark dragons are yoked, and the jade carriage drives with flowing tassels.
units.literal: Four dark dragons yoked; the jade carriage drives with flowing tassels.

units.zh: 觚陛展躬祠。
units.en: At the goblet steps he performs the sacrifice in person.
units.literal: On goblet steps he performs the sacrifice in person.

units.zh: 長梢飾玉，翠羽秀金支。
units.en: Long branches are adorned with jade, and green feathers grace the golden branches.
units.literal: Long branches adorned with jade; green feathers grace golden branches.

units.zh: 華始倡，雅韻出宮垂。
units.en: Splendid music begins the lead, and elegant tones issue from the palace hall.
units.literal: Splendid music begins and leads; elegant tones issue from the palace and hang down.

units.zh: 神來下，雲車風馬，繽晻藹，宴棲遲。
units.en: The spirit descends in cloud chariots and wind horses through rich dim mist, feasting and lingering long.
units.literal: The spirit descends; cloud chariots and wind horses; rich and dim mist; feasting and dwelling long.

units.zh: 畢觴流胙，柴煙竣事，棠梨回謁，宣室受蕃厘。
units.en: When libations end and sacrificial flesh is distributed, firewood smoke marks completion; homage is paid at Tangli, and abundant blessings are received in the Xuan Chamber.
units.literal: When the libation is finished, sacrificial flesh flows; firewood smoke marks completion; returning to pay homage at Tangli; receiving abundant blessings in the Xuan Chamber.

units.zh: 盛德無心專饗，端為民祈。
units.en: With abundant virtue and no self-seeking in the feast, he uprightly prays for the people.
units.literal: Abundant virtue without self-seeking devotion to the feast; uprightly praying for the people.

units.zh: 雲恩有截，雨澤霈無涯。
units.en: Cloud grace reaches every boundary, and rain's bounty pours without limit.
units.literal: Cloud grace reaches everywhere; rain bounty pours without bound.

units.zh: 君王愉樂，和氣溢瑤卮。
units.en: The lord-king rejoices, and harmonious qi overflows the jade goblet.
units.literal: The lord-king joyful and pleased; harmonious qi overflows the jade goblet.

units.zh: 壽天齊，長擁神基。
units.en: His lifespan equals heaven's, long securing the spirit foundation.
units.literal: Lifespan equal to heaven; long holding the spirit foundation.

units.zh: 《奉禋歌》
units.en: Song of the Suburban Sacrifice
units.literal: 《Song of the Suburban Sacrifice》

units.zh: 葭飛璿籥初陽，雲絕清台薦景祥。
units.en: Reeds rise in the jade pitch pipes at first yang, clouds clear, and the Clear Terrace presents auspicious scenes.
units.literal: Reeds fly in the jade pitch pipes at first yang; clouds cease; the Clear Terrace presents auspicious scenes.

units.zh: 風應律，日重光。
units.en: The wind answers the pitch pipes, and the sun's light is renewed.
units.literal: Wind responds to the pitch pipes; the sun's light is renewed.

units.zh: 歲功順，底金穰。
units.en: The year's harvest proceeds smoothly to golden abundance.
units.literal: The year's achievement goes smoothly; reaching golden abundance.

units.zh: 壽而康，庭壼樂無疆。
units.en: Long life and health, and inner court joy without end.
units.literal: Long life and health; inner court joy without bound.

units.zh: 皇展報，新禮樂，觚陛詠賓鄉，珠幄熉黃。
units.en: The emperor presents the report with new ritual music, chanting at the goblet steps, beneath pearl awnings warm with yellow.
units.literal: The emperor displays the report; new ritual music; at goblet steps chanting the guest village; pearl awning warm yellow.

units.zh: 登瑞糸巢，陳俎豆，澹嘉觴。
units.en: Ascending the auspicious silken nest, flesh and grain dishes are set out, and fine libations are poured.
units.literal: Ascending the auspicious silken nest; setting out flesh and grain dishes; pouring fine libations.

units.zh: 袞衣煇煥，寶珮琳琅，奠椒漿。
units.en: Dragon robes shine brilliantly, precious pendants chime and glitter, and peppered libation is offered.
units.literal: Dragon robes shine brilliant; precious pendants glitter and ring; offering peppered libation.

units.zh: 慶陰陰，神來下，鳳翥龍驤。
units.en: In deepening celebration the spirit descends, the phoenix soaring and the dragon prancing.
units.literal: Celebration dark and dim; the spirit descends; phoenix soars, dragon prances.

units.zh: 靈燕喜，錫符仍降嘏，鏞管琳琅歡亮。
units.en: The spirits feast with joy, talismans bestow blessing, and bells and pipes ring bright with gladness.
units.literal: Spirits rejoice in feasting; talismans still bestow blessing; bells and pipes glitter and ring, bright with joy.

units.zh: 神之出，祓蘭堂。
units.en: As the spirit departs, purification is performed at the orchid hall.
units.literal: As the spirit departs, purifying at the orchid hall.

units.zh: 輦路天香，輕煙半襲旂常，祉滂洋。
units.en: Heaven's fragrance fills the imperial way, light smoke half enfolds the banners, and blessings pour vast.
units.literal: On the imperial path heaven's fragrance; light smoke half enfolds the banners; blessings pour vast.

units.zh: 受厘宣室，返馭齋房，恩與風翔。
units.en: Blessings are received in the Xuan Chamber; the carriage returns to the fasting chamber, and grace flies with the wind.
units.literal: Receiving blessings in the Xuan Chamber; returning the carriage to the fasting chamber; grace flies with the wind.

units.zh: 華封祝，皇來有慶，八荒同壽，寶曆無疆。
units.en: Huafeng blessings are offered; the sovereign comes with celebration; the eight wildernesses share long life, and the precious calendar knows no end.
units.literal: Huafeng blessings; the sovereign comes with celebration; eight wildernesses share long life; the precious calendar without bound.

units.zh: 《降仙台》
units.en: Descending Immortal Terrace
units.literal: 《Descending Immortal Terrace》

units.zh: 星芒收采，雲容放曉，羲馭漸揚明。
units.en: Star rays are gathered and stilled, clouds release the dawn, and the sun chariot gradually brightens.
units.literal: Star rays gathered and stilled; cloud forms release the dawn; Xi the driver's chariot gradually raises brightness.

units.zh: 觚壇竣事霽，風襲袞衣輕，鑾路塵清。
units.en: The goblet altar rite is complete and skies have cleared; wind brushes the dragon robes lightly, and the imperial path lies dust-free.
units.literal: The goblet altar rite completed and skies clear; wind brushes the dragon robes lightly; the imperial path's dust is clean.

units.zh: 甘泉鹵簿祲威肅，回軫旋衡。
units.en: At Ganquan the guard of honor stands in solemn majesty as wheels turn and the balance pivots homeward.
units.literal: At Ganquan's guard of honor august majesty is solemn; wheels turn, the balance pivots.

units.zh: 千官導從粲簪纓，鈞奏間《韶》、《英》。
units.en: A thousand officials guide and follow, caps and tassels gleaming, while great music intersperses the 《Shao》 and 《Ying》.
units.literal: A thousand officials guide and follow, brilliant with caps and tassels; great music intersperses 《Shao》 and 《Ying》.

units.zh: 瞻龍闈，近鳳城。
units.en: They gaze at the dragon gate and draw near the phoenix city.
units.literal: Gazing at the dragon gate; approaching the phoenix city.

units.zh: 都人雲會，芬茀夾道歡迎。
units.en: The capital's people gather like clouds, fragrant offerings lining the road in welcome.
units.literal: Capital people gather like clouds; fragrant offerings line the road in welcome.

units.zh: 宸極尊榮。
units.en: The imperial pole stands in honored glory.
units.literal: The imperial pole—honored glory.

units.zh: 卮玉慶熙成，瓊樓天上起和聲。
units.en: Jade goblets celebrate the glorious completion, and jade towers in heaven raise harmonious sound.
units.literal: Jade goblets celebrate the glorious completion; jade towers in heaven raise harmonious sounds.

units.zh: 布春澤，洪暢寰瀛。
units.en: Spring's bounty is spread, vastly flowing through all lands within the seas.
units.literal: Spreading spring's bounty; vastly flowing through all lands within the seas.

units.zh: 嵩呼萬歲鼇三抃，頌升平。
units.en: From Songshan comes the cry of ten thousand years, the sea turtle thrice claps, praising ascending peace.
units.literal: Songshan calls ten thousand years; the sea turtle thrice claps; praising ascending peace.

units.zh: 明堂大禮四首《合宮歌》
units.en: Four pieces for the Bright Hall great rite: 《Harmonious Palace Song》
units.literal: Bright Hall great rite, four pieces: 《Harmonious Palace Song》

units.zh: 聖明朝，曠典乘秋舉，大饗本仁祖。
units.en: In the sage dynasty's morning, the grand ancient rite is held in autumn, and the great feast honors the benevolent ancestor.
units.literal: In the sage dynasty's morning; the grand ancient rite seizes autumn to be held; the great feast originates from the benevolent ancestor.

units.zh: 九室八牖四戶，敕躬齊戒格堪輿。
units.en: Nine chambers, eight windows, four doors—the emperor fasts in person to reach heaven and earth.
units.literal: Nine chambers, eight windows, four doors; commanded in person to fast and abstain, reaching heaven and earth.

units.zh: 盛牲實俎，並侑總稽古。
units.en: Full victims fill the stands, and joint secondary offerings follow ancient precedent entirely.
units.literal: Full victims fill the stands; joint secondary offerings all follow ancient precedent.

units.zh: 玉露乍肅天宇，冰輪下照金鋪。
units.en: Jade dew suddenly chills the sky, and the moon-wheel descends to shine upon the golden gate.
units.literal: Jade dew suddenly chills the heavenly canopy; the ice wheel descends to shine on golden settings.

units.zh: 燎煙噓，鬱尊香，《雲門》舞。
units.en: Blaze smoke rises, rich honored fragrance fills the air, and the 《Cloud Gate》 dance is performed.
units.literal: Blaze smoke exhales; rich honored fragrance; the 《Cloud Gate》 dance.

units.zh: 仿佛翔坐，靈心鹹嘉娛。
units.en: Seemingly hovering in seat, all spirit hearts rejoice in fine delight.
units.literal: Seemingly hovering seated; the spirit heart all rejoices in fine delight.

units.zh: 眾星俞，美光屬，照熉珠。
units.en: Myriad stars answer, beautiful light attaches, shining upon warm pearls.
units.literal: Myriad stars answer; beautiful light attaches; shining warm pearls.

units.zh: 清曉禦丹儀，湛恩遍浹率溥，歡聲雷動嶽鎮呼。
units.en: At clear dawn the cinnabar rite is performed; deep grace soaks all broadly; joyous sounds thunder as mountains and peaks call out.
units.literal: Clear dawn performs the cinnabar rite; deep grace thoroughly soaks and spreads widely; joyous sounds thunder like mountains and peaks calling.

units.zh: 徐命法駕，萬騎花盈路。
units.en: Slowly the ritual carriage is ordered forth, ten thousand riders and flowers filling the road.
units.literal: Slowly commanding the ritual carriage; ten thousand riders, flowers filling the road.

units.zh: 萬姓齊祝，壽同天地，事超唐、虞。
units.en: All the people bless together, wishing long life equal to heaven and earth, achievements surpassing Tang and Yu.
units.literal: Ten thousand surnames together bless; lifespan equal to heaven and earth; achievements surpass Tang and Yu.

units.zh: 看平燕雲，從此興文偃武，待重會諸侯舊東都。
units.en: Look to pacifying Yan and Yun—from this let culture flourish and weapons rest, awaiting again the feudal lords at the old eastern capital.
units.literal: Look to pacifying Yan and Yun; from this cultural flourishing and weapons stilled; awaiting again gathering the feudal lords at the old eastern capital.

units.zh: 《六州》
units.en: Six Prefectures
units.literal: 《Six Prefectures》

units.zh: 商秋肅，嘉會協中辛。
units.en: Autumn solemnity, the auspicious assembly falls on the mid-xin day.
units.literal: Autumn of Shang is solemn; the auspicious assembly agrees with mid-xin day.

units.zh: 涓路寢，修禋祀，聖德昭清。
units.en: The purified road is stilled, suburban rites prepared, and sage virtue manifests in clarity.
units.literal: The purified road is stilled; suburban rites are prepared; sage virtue manifests in clarity.

units.zh: 端誌慮，罄竭齋精。
units.en: With upright intent, he exhausts all fasting purity.
units.literal: Upright intent and concern; exhaustively expending fasting purity.

units.zh: 錦繡排天仗，羽衛繽紛。
units.en: Brocade and embroidery array the heavenly guard, feathered guards in splendid array.
units.literal: Brocade and embroidery array the heavenly guard; feathered guards in crowding splendor.

units.zh: 朝太室，返中宸，被袞接神明。
units.en: He pays audience at the Grand Chamber, returns to the central palace, and in dragon robes receives the spirits.
units.literal: Audience at the Grand Chamber; returning to the central palace; wearing dragon robes to receive the spirits.

units.zh: 時平天地俱清晏，兼金行萬寶，物盛藹清馨。
units.en: Times are peaceful, heaven and earth clear and calm, gold and bronze move with myriad treasures, and all things abound in pure fragrance.
units.literal: Times peaceful, heaven and earth together clear and calm; gold and bronze move with myriad treasures; things abound, lush with pure fragrance.

units.zh: 瞻熉座，舂容矣燕三靈。
units.en: Gazing at the warm throne, harmonious and at ease, feasting the three spirits.
units.literal: Gazing at the warm throne; harmonious and at ease, feasting the three spirits.

units.zh: 奠瑤爵，薦量幣，清思窈冥冥。
units.en: Jade goblets are set out, measured silk is offered, pure thought runs deep and dark.
units.literal: Setting out jade goblets; presenting measured silk; pure thought deep and dark.

units.zh: 望昆侖，輸嘉祥，塞絪縕。
units.en: Gazing toward Kunlun, auspicious omens are conveyed, filling the misty haze.
units.literal: Gazing at Kunlun; conveying auspicious omens; filling the misty haze.

units.zh: 誠殫禮洽慶休成，潤澤被生民。
units.en: Sincerity is exhausted, rites harmonized, celebration achieved gloriously, and moistening bounty covers the people.
units.literal: Sincerity exhausted, rites harmonized, celebration gloriously achieved; moistening bounty covers the living people.

units.zh: 端門肆眚，昕庭稱賀，俱將戩穀萬壽祝明君。
units.en: At the Gate of Correctness amnesty is proclaimed, at the dawn court congratulations offered, all offering myriad years to bless the clear lord.
units.literal: At the Gate of Correctness amnesty is proclaimed; at the dawn court congratulations are offered; all will offer myriad years blessing the clear lord.

units.zh: 《十二時》
units.en: Twelve Hours
units.literal: 《Twelve Hours》

units.zh: 炎圖鞏，天祚昌期，聖德茂重離。
units.en: The fiery chart is secured, heaven's mandate in a flourishing age, sage virtue luxuriant in Chongli.
units.literal: The fiery chart is secured; heaven's mandate in a flourishing age; sage virtue luxuriant in Chongli.

units.zh: 英明經遠，濬哲昭微。
units.en: Brilliant and wise, reaching far; profound wisdom manifesting the subtle.
units.literal: Brilliant and wise, extending far; profound wisdom manifesting the subtle.

units.zh: 寶儉更深慈。
units.en: He cherishes frugality and deeper kindness.
units.literal: Cherishing frugality, deeper kindness.

units.zh: 觀萬國累洽重熙。
units.en: Behold all nations in repeated harmony and repeated glory.
units.literal: Behold all nations repeatedly harmonious, repeatedly glorious.

units.zh: 對時報禮秩神祗，玉帛湊華夷。
units.en: Matching the season, rites report to the spirits; jade and silk gather from China and beyond.
units.literal: Matching the season to report the rites, honoring the spirits; jade and silk gather from China and barbarians.

units.zh: 肅雍顯相，百辟盡欽祗。
units.en: Solemn and harmonious ministers are displayed, and all the hundred ministers stand in full reverence.
units.literal: Solemn and harmonious, ministers displayed; all the hundred ministers fully reverent.

units.zh: 奄嘉虞，英璧奠華滋。
units.en: Fine offerings cover the altar; splendid jade bi placed upon flourishing abundance.
units.literal: Covering the fine offerings; splendid jade bi placed upon flourishing abundance.

units.zh: 神安坐，景氣澄虛極，光焰燭長麗。
units.en: The spirit sits at ease; the atmosphere clears at the void pole; flames of light illuminate all that is long and fair.
units.literal: The spirit sits at ease; the atmosphere clear at the void pole; flames of light illuminate the long and beautiful.

units.zh: 展詩應律，萬舞逶遲，三獻洽皇儀。
units.en: Odes are displayed answering the pitch pipes, myriad dances wind slow, three offerings harmonize the imperial rite.
units.literal: Displaying odes responding to pitch pipes; myriad dances winding slow; three offerings harmonizing the imperial rite.

units.zh: 垂靈祲，慶祐來宜，禮無違。
units.en: Spirit omens descend, blessing and protection come as they should, and no rite is violated.
units.literal: Descending spirit omens; blessing and protection come appropriately; rites without violation.

units.zh: 鳴鑾臨帝闕，飛鳳下天倪。
units.en: Imperial bells sound as they reach the god gate, and flying phoenixes descend from heaven's edge.
units.literal: Sounding the imperial bells arriving at the god gate; flying phoenixes descend from heaven's margin.

units.zh: 清和寰宇，霈澤一朝馳。
units.en: Clear harmony fills the realm, and pouring bounty rushes forth in a single morning.
units.literal: Clear harmony throughout the realm; pouring bounty rushes forth in one morning.

units.zh: 醇化無為，萬祀鞏丕基。
units.en: Pure transformation without striving, myriad sacrifices securing the grand foundation.
units.literal: Pure transformation without effort; myriad sacrifices securing the grand foundation.

units.zh: 《導引》
units.en: Processional
units.literal: 《Processional》

units.zh: 合宮親饗，青女肅長空，精意與天通。
units.en: At the Harmonious Palace the emperor feasts in person; the Green Woman solemnifies the long sky, and pure intent connects with heaven.
units.literal: At the Harmonious Palace the emperor feasts in person; the Green Woman solemnifies the long sky; pure intent connects with heaven's path.

units.zh: 後皇臨顧誰為侑？
units.en: Sovereign Earth looks down in regard—who shall serve as secondary offering?
units.literal: Sovereign Earth looks down in regard—who shall be secondary offering?

units.zh: 文祖暨神功。
units.en: The cultured forebear—and divine merit complete.
units.literal: The cultured forebear and divine achievement.

units.zh: 函蒙祉福歲常豐，聲教被華戎。
units.en: Heaven's grace brings blessing and fortune, harvests ever full; royal teaching reaches China and all beyond.
units.literal: Heaven's grace covers blessing and fortune, years always abundant; voice and teaching spread over China and the barbarians.

units.zh: 兩宮眉壽同榮樂，戩穀永來崇。
units.en: Both palaces share long life, equal glory, and joy; myriad years of blessing rise in lofty honor.
units.literal: Both palaces share eyebrow-longevity and equal glory and joy; myriad years forever come in lofty honor.

units.zh: 乾道發太上皇帝、太上皇后冊寶《導引》一首
units.en: Qiandao era: one Processional for the issuance of seals and regalia to the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress.
units.literal: Qiandao era: one piece of 《Processional》 for the issuance of seals and regalia to the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress.

units.zh: 重華真主，晨夕奉庭闈，禋祀慶成時。
units.en: Chonghua's true lord, morning and evening tending the inner court—when the burnt offering rite is gloriously complete.
units.literal: The true lord of Chonghua, morning and evening serving the court quarters; when the burnt offering rite's celebration is complete.

units.zh: 乾元坤載同歸美，寶冊兩光輝。
units.en: Heaven and earth alike return their praise; both precious registers shine with glory.
units.literal: Heaven's origin and earth's burden alike return beauty; the precious registers both radiate glory.

units.zh: 斑衣何似赭黃衣，此事古今稀。
units.en: What is motley dress beside the ochre-yellow robe? Such a thing is rare in all ages.
units.literal: How does multicolored dress compare with ochre-yellow robes? Such a thing is rare in past and present.

units.zh: 都人歡樂嵩呼震，聖壽總天齊。
units.en: The capital rejoices, cheers like thunder on Mount Song; sage longevity equals heaven itself.
units.literal: Capital people rejoicing, Songshan cheers shaking; sage longevity in total equal with heaven.

units.zh: 淳熙發太上皇帝、太上皇后冊寶《導引》一首
units.en: Chunxi era: one Processional for the issuance of seals and regalia to the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress.
units.literal: Chunxi era: one piece of 《Processional》 for the issuance of seals and regalia to the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress.

units.zh: 新陽初應，樂事起彤庭，和氣滿吳京。
units.en: The new sun first answers; joy rises from the crimson court, and harmonizing breath fills the capital.
units.literal: The new yang first responds; happy affairs rise from the cinnabar court; harmonizing qi fills the Wu capital.

units.zh: 家來慶東皇壽，西母共長生。
units.en: All celebrate the Eastern Sovereign's long life; the Queen Mother of the West shares immortality.
units.literal: The house comes to celebrate the Eastern Sovereign's longevity; the Western Mother shares eternal life.

units.zh: 金書玉篆粲龍文，前導沸歡聲。
units.en: Gold inscriptions and jade seal-script gleam with dragon patterns; the forward escort surges with joyous cries.
units.literal: Gold inscriptions and jade seal script glitter with dragon patterns; the forward escort boils over with joyous cries.

units.zh: 修齡無極名無盡，一歲一回增。
units.en: A cultivated age without limit, a name without end—each year another year is added.
units.literal: Cultivated age without limit, fame without end; one year, one increment added.

units.zh: 加上太上皇帝、太上皇后冊寶《導引》一首
units.en: One Processional for adding seals and regalia to the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress.
units.literal: One piece of 《Processional》 for adding seals and regalia to the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress.

units.zh: 皇家多慶，親壽與天長，德業播輝光。
units.en: The imperial house abounds in celebration; parental longevity matches heaven; virtue and achievement spread their radiance.
units.literal: The imperial house has many celebrations; parental longevity matches heaven's length; virtue and achievement spread radiant light.

units.zh: 焜煌寶冊來清禁，玉篆映金相。
units.en: Resplendent precious registers enter the inner palace; jade seal-script gleams against golden splendor.
units.literal: Resplendent precious registers come to the pure forbidden precinct; jade seal script reflects golden countenance.

units.zh: 庭闈尊奉會明昌，佳氣溢康莊。
units.en: The inner court receives them in honor amid bright prosperity; fine auspicious breath fills the broad avenue.
units.literal: The court quarters receive in honor and meet bright prosperity; fine qi overflows the broad avenue.

units.zh: 洪禧申輯名增衍，億載頌無疆。
units.en: Great auspicious joy extends the gathered names; praise without bound for a hundred million years.
units.literal: Great auspicious joy extends gathered names and added elaboration; a hundred million years praised without bound.

units.zh: 恭上壽聖皇太后、至尊壽皇聖帝、壽成皇后尊號冊寶《導引》一首
units.en: One Processional for reverently bestowing honorary titles and regalia upon Empress Dowager Shousheng, the Supreme Sagely Emperor Shouhuang, and Empress Chengcheng.
units.literal: One piece of 《Processional》 for reverently bestowing honorary titles and seals and regalia upon Empress Dowager Shousheng, the Supreme Sagely Emperor Shouhuang, and Empress Chengcheng.

units.zh: 皇家盛事，三殿慶重重，聖主極推崇。
units.en: A grand affair of the imperial house—three halls celebrate in layers upon layers; the sage sovereign is exalted to utmost reverence.
units.literal: An imperial house grand event; three halls celebrate layer upon layer; the sage lord is exalted to utmost reverence.

units.zh: 瑤編寶列相輝映，歸美意何窮。
units.en: Jade-bound volumes and precious arrays shine upon one another; the intent to return praise knows no end.
units.literal: Jade-bound volumes and precious arrays reflect one another; returning beauty—intent without end.

units.zh: 鈞《韶》九奏度春風，彩仗煥儀容。
units.en: The sacred Shaoyin, nine performances on the spring wind; colored halberds renew the ceremonial splendor.
units.literal: The harmonized 《Shaoyin》, nine performances riding the spring wind; colored halberds renew ceremonial bearing.

units.zh: 歡聲和氣彌寰宇，皇壽與天同。
units.en: Joyful cries and harmonizing breath fill the realm; imperial longevity is one with heaven.
units.literal: Joyful cries and harmonizing qi fill the whole realm; imperial longevity matches heaven.

units.zh: 加上壽聖皇太后尊號冊寶《導引》一首
units.en: One Processional for adding an honorary title and regalia to Empress Dowager Shousheng.
units.literal: One piece of 《Processional》 for adding an honorary title and seals and regalia to Empress Dowager Shousheng.

units.zh: 重親萬壽，八帙衍新元，禮典備文孫。
units.en: Doubly honoring parents' long life; eighty years mark the new era; ritual codes complete—the cultured grandson.
units.literal: Doubly honoring parents' myriad longevity; eight scroll-volumes extending the new era; ritual codes complete, the cultured grandson.

units.zh: 溫溫和氣迎長日，寶冊煥瑤琨。
units.en: Warm harmonizing breath greets the lengthening day; precious registers gleam like fine jade.
units.literal: Warm warm harmonizing qi greets the lengthening day; precious registers shine like fine jade.

units.zh: 徽音顯號自堯門，德行已該存。
units.en: Fine repute and manifest title from Yao's gate—virtue and conduct already fully preserved.
units.literal: Fine repute and manifest title from the Gate of Yao; virtue and conduct already fully preserved.

units.zh: 更期昌算齊箕翼，愈久愈崇尊。
units.en: We look for flourishing years like the Winnow Basket and Wings stars—ever longer, ever more revered.
units.literal: Further expecting flourishing years equal to the Winnow Basket and Wings; the longer, the loftier the reverence.

units.zh: 嘉泰二年加上壽成太皇太后冊寶《導引》一首
units.en: Jiatai year 2: one Processional for adding seals and regalia to Grand Empress Dowager Chengcheng.
units.literal: Jiatai year 2: one piece of 《Processional》 for adding seals and regalia to Grand Empress Dowager Chengcheng.

units.zh: 思齊文母，盛德比薑、任，擁佑極恩深。
units.en: Striving to equal the cultured mother, virtue flourishing like Jiang and Ren—shielding protection, grace profound beyond measure.
units.literal: Striving to equal the cultured mother; flourishing virtue comparable to Jiang and Ren; shielding support, utmost grace deep.

units.zh: 湯孫歸美熙鴻號，鏤玉更繩金。
units.en: Tang's descendant returns praise in a glorious vast title; jade carved and further bound with golden cord.
units.literal: Tang's descendant returns praise in the glorious vast title; carved jade further bound with gold cord.

units.zh: 虞廷萬辟萃華簪，法仗儼天臨。
units.en: At Yu's court myriad officials gather in splendid caps; ceremonial halberds stand solemn, heaven itself descending.
units.literal: At the Yu court myriad officials gather in splendid caps; law halberds solemn as heaven descends.

units.zh: 層闈慶典年年舉，千古播徽音。
units.en: At the layered palace gates, celebratory rites are held year after year; fine repute spreads through a thousand ages.
units.literal: Layered palace gates—celebratory rites held year after year; a thousand ages spread fine repute.

units.zh: 親耕籍田四首
units.en: Four pieces: the emperor's personal plowing of the sacred field.
units.literal: Four pieces for the emperor's personal plowing of the sacred field.

units.zh: 《導引》
units.en: Processional
units.literal: 《Processional》

units.zh: 春融日暖，四野瑞煙浮，柳菀更桑柔。
units.en: Spring melts the cold, the sun grows warm; auspicious mist floats over the four wilds—willows lush, mulberry tender.
units.literal: Spring melts, sun warm; the four wilds' auspicious mist floats; willows lush, mulberry more soft.

units.zh: 土膏脈起條風扇，宿雪潤田疇。
units.en: Earth's rich ointment pulses, the spring wind stirs; lingering snow moistens the furrowed fields.
units.literal: Earth's ointment pulses rising, the slender wind fans; lingering snow moistens the fields.

units.zh: 金根轂轉如雷動，羽衙擁貔貅。
units.en: Golden chariot wheels turn like thunder; feathered guards escort the imperial host.
units.literal: Golden wheel hubs turn like thunder moving; feathered guards escort the brave warriors.

units.zh: 扶攜老稚康衢滿，延跂望凝旒。
units.en: Old and young helped along fill the broad street; on tiptoe they gaze at the imperial canopy.
units.literal: Supporting old and young, the broad street full; stretching on tiptoe, gazing at the fixed tassels.

units.zh: 鬥移星轉，一氣又環周，六府要時修。
units.en: The Dipper shifts, the stars turn—one breath cycles round again; the six storehouses must be kept in season.
units.literal: The Dipper shifts, stars turn; one qi again cycles round; the six storehouses must be timely maintained.

units.zh: 務農重穀人胥勸，耕籍禮殊尤。
units.en: Farming honored, grain prized—all alike are encouraged; the plowing rite stands especially supreme.
units.literal: Devoted to farming, grain is prized—all people alike encouraged; plowing-the-field rite especially outstanding.

units.zh: 壇壝嶽峙文明地，黛耜駕青牛。
units.en: Altar walls rise peak-like on hallowed ground; dark plowshares yoked to green oxen.
units.literal: Altar walls stand like peaks at the civilized ground; dark plowshare yoked to green oxen.

units.zh: 雍容南畝三推了，玉趾更遲留。
units.en: With dignified ease on the southern plots—three furrows done—yet the jade-foot sovereign lingers still.
units.literal: With dignified ease the southern plots—three pushes completed; jade toes further linger.

units.zh: 《六州》
units.en: Six Prefectures
units.literal: 《Six Prefectures》

units.zh: 昭聖武，不戰屈人兵。
units.en: Sage martial glory shown—foes yield without battle.
units.literal: Manifest sage martiality; without battle, others' armies submit.

units.zh: 幹戈戢，烽燧息，海宇清寧。
units.en: Arms are stowed, beacon fires die—the realm under heaven clear and still.
units.literal: Shield and spear stowed; beacon fires cease; seas and realm clear and peaceful.

units.zh: 民豐業，歌詠升平。
units.en: The people prosper in their trade; songs rise in praise of peace.
units.literal: People abundant in livelihood; songs and chants of rising peace.

units.zh: 願鹹歸畎畝，力穡為。
units.en: All would return to field and furrow; strength bent to the tiller's work.
units.literal: All wish to return to furrow and field; exerting strength in tilling as their work.

units.zh: 經界正，東作西成。
units.en: Field boundaries stand true—east sows, west reaps.
units.literal: Field boundaries set right; east sows, west harvests.

units.zh: 農務軫皇情，躬親耒耜，相勸深耕。
units.en: Farm work weighs upon the imperial heart—the ruler handles plow and hoe, urging deep tillage together.
units.literal: Farm affairs weigh on the imperial heart; personally handling plow and hoe; mutual encouragement in deep plowing.

units.zh: 人心感悅，擊壤沸歡聲。
units.en: Hearts are moved to joy; clod-beating cheers boil over.
units.literal: People's hearts moved to joy; beating clods boiling with happy cries.

units.zh: 乘鸞輅，羽旗彩仗鮮明。
units.en: Riding the phoenix carriage—feather banners and colored halberds shine clear.
units.literal: Riding the phoenix carriage; feather banners and colored halberds bright and clear.

units.zh: 傳清蹕，行黃道，緹騎出重城。
units.en: Clear imperial progress passes along the sacred way—cavalry in russet file out of the walled city.
units.literal: Passing the clear imperial progress; traveling the yellow path; cavalry in russet file out of the layered city.

units.zh: 仰瞻日表映朱紘，環佩更鏘鳴。
units.en: Gazing up—the sovereign's sunlike aspect gleams through vermillion tassels; girdle pendants ring clear.
units.literal: Looking up to view the sun's form reflecting vermillion tassels; girdle pendants further ring clear.

units.zh: 百執公卿，不辭染屨意專精，準擬奉粢盛。
units.en: Officers and nobles by the hundred—undeterred by mud-stained shoes, intent devoted—ready to offer the sacrificial grain.
units.literal: Hundred officers and nobles; not declining mud-stained shoes, intent devoted and refined; prepared to offer sacrificial grain.

units.zh: 田多稼，風行遐邇，家家給足，胥慶三登。
units.en: Fields heavy with grain—the blessing spreads far and near; every household is supplied; all rejoice in triple harvest.
units.literal: Fields many with grain; the wind spreads far and near; every house supplied in full; all celebrate thrice harvest.

units.zh: 《十二時》
units.en: Twelve Hours
units.literal: 《Twelve Hours》

units.zh: 臨寰宇，恭己岩廊，屬意在耕桑。
units.en: Overlooking all under heaven, the self restrained in the mountain hall—intent fixed on farming and silk.
units.literal: Overlooking all under heaven; reverently restraining the self in the rocky gallery; fixing intent upon farming and sericulture.

units.zh: 愛民利物，德邁陶唐，躋俗盡淳厖。
units.en: Loving the people, nurturing all things—virtue surpassing Yao and Tang; customs rise to pure abundance.
units.literal: Loving the people, benefiting things; virtue surpassing Yao and Tang; raising custom to complete simplicity and abundance.

units.zh: 開千畝，帝籍神倉。
units.en: The thousand mu are opened—the emperor's sacred field and the divine granary.
units.literal: Opening the thousand mu; the emperor's field and the god granary.

units.zh: 舉彝章，祗祓壇場，為農事祈祥。
units.en: Canonical rites are raised; the altar ground purified in reverence—auspice sought for the farming season.
units.literal: Raising canonical statutes; reverently purifying the altar ground; praying auspice for farming affairs.

units.zh: 涓辰行禮，節物值春陽。
units.en: The day is chosen for rite—seasonal offerings meet the spring sun.
units.literal: Selecting the day to perform rites; seasonal things meeting spring yang.

units.zh: 罄齊莊，明德薦馨香。
units.en: Reverent solemnity is complete; bright virtue offers fragrant incense.
units.literal: Exhausting reverent solemnity; bright virtue offering fragrant aromas.

units.zh: 宮禁邃，嬪妃並禦侍，穜稑獻君王。
units.en: Deep within the palace, consorts attend together—early and late grain presented to the sovereign.
units.literal: Palace depths secluded; consorts together attend in service; early and late grain presented to the king lord.

units.zh: 中闈表率，陰教逾光。
units.en: The inner quarters set the example; feminine teaching shines ever brighter.
units.literal: Inner quarters' model conduct; yin teaching surpasses in radiance.

units.zh: 帳殿靄熉黃，梐枑設，翠幕高張，慶雲翔。
units.en: The canopy hall glows warm yellow; hitching posts stand, green curtains rise high—celebratory clouds soar.
units.literal: Canopy hall hazy with warm yellow; hitching posts set; green curtains raised high; celebratory clouds soar.

units.zh: 尊罍陳酒醴，金石奏宮商。
units.en: Wine vessels stand filled; metal and stone instruments play the gong and shang modes.
units.literal: Vessels set out with wine and sweet liquor; metal and stone play gong and shang modes.

units.zh: 神靈感格，歲歲富倉箱。
units.en: Spirits are moved and descend—year after year granaries overflow.
units.literal: Spirits moved and arrived; year after year rich granaries and bins.

units.zh: 慶明昌，行旅不齎糧。
units.en: Bright prosperity is celebrated—travelers need carry no provisions.
units.literal: Celebrating bright prosperity; travelers need not carry provisions.

units.zh: 《奉禋歌》
units.en: Song of the Suburban Sacrifice
units.literal: 《Song of the Suburban Sacrifice》

units.zh: 吾皇端立太平基，奉祀肅雍格神祗。
units.en: Our sovereign stands upright, founding great peace—offering sacrifice, reverent and harmonious, the spirits descend.
units.literal: Our emperor upright establishes the foundation of great peace; offering sacrifices, reverent and harmonious, the spirits arrive.

units.zh: 撫禦耦，降嘉種，何辭手攬洪縻。
units.en: He pats the yoked oxen, fine seed is bestowed—why hold back from grasping the great plow-lines?
units.literal: Patting the yoked pair; descending fine seed; why decline with hand to grasp the great halters?

units.zh: 命太史視日，祗告前期。
units.en: The Grand Clerk is ordered to observe the sun—the prior date reverently announced.
units.literal: Ordering the Grand Clerk to observe the sun; reverently announcing the prior term.

units.zh: 驗穹象，天田入望更光輝。
units.en: The heaven-signs are verified—the sacred field comes into view, more radiant still.
units.literal: Verifying the vaulted signs; the heaven field entering view more radiant.

units.zh: 掌禮陳儀，蒐钜典，迎春令，頒宣溫詔，遍九圍，人盡熙熙。
units.en: Rite officers set out the ceremony, great codes gathered—spring welcomed, warm edicts spread through the nine realms, and all people rejoice.
units.literal: Rite officers set out ceremony; gathering great canonical codes; welcoming spring's command; promulgating warm edicts; throughout the nine regions; all people entirely joyful.

units.zh: 仰明時，儼垂衣，佳氣氤氳表厖禧。
units.en: Looking up at the bright age, robes fall in solemn ease—fine auspicious breath misty with vast blessing.
units.literal: Looking up at the bright age; solemnly letting robes fall; fine qi misty displays vast auspiciousness.

units.zh: 豐年屢，大田生異粟，含滋吐秀，九種傳圖，盡來丹闕，瑞應昌時。
units.en: Abundant years come again—great fields bear wondrous grain, rich and flourishing; nine kinds recorded in charts arrive at the crimson palace—auspicious signs for a flourishing age.
units.literal: Abundant years repeatedly; great fields produce strange grain; holding moisture, spitting brilliance; nine kinds passed in charts; all come to the cinnabar gate-tower; auspicious response to a flourishing age.

units.zh: 亨運正當攝提，佇見詠京坻。
units.en: Prosperous fortune stands at Sheti—we await the ode of heaped grain at the capital.
units.literal: A prosperous fortune just at Sheti; awaiting to see chants of the capital mound.

units.zh: 躬稼穡，重耘耔。
units.en: The sovereign works the grain—hoeing and weeding again.
units.literal: Personally doing grain work; again hoeing and weeding.

units.zh: 盛禮興行先百姓，崇本業，憂勤如禹、稷，播在聲詩。
units.en: Grand rites rise before the people—root occupations honored, diligence like Yu and Ji—spread in song and ode.
units.literal: Grand rites rise and proceed before the hundred people; honoring root occupations; worry and diligence like Yu and Ji; sown in song and ode.

units.zh: 顯仁皇后上仙發引三首《導引》
units.en: Three Processionals for Empress Xianren's ascent to immortality and the funeral procession's departure.
units.literal: Three pieces of 《Processional》 for Empress Xianren's ascent to immortality and the departure of the funeral procession.

units.zh: 長樂晚，彩戲萊衣，奄忽夢報仙期。
units.en: Late at Everlasting Joy, in motley dress at play—suddenly a dream announces the immortal's hour.
units.literal: Late at Everlasting Joy; colorful play of garden joy—suddenly a dream reports the immortal's appointed time.

units.zh: 帝鄉渺渺乘鸞去，啼紅嬪禦不勝悲，蒼梧煙水杳難追。
units.en: The celestial realm far away—she rides the phoenix and departs; palace ladies weep crimson, grief beyond bearing; Cangwu's misty waters fade beyond pursuit.
units.literal: The emperor's home distant and far—riding the phoenix she departs; weeping red, palace ladies cannot bear grief; Cangwu's misty waters remote, hard to pursue.

units.zh: 腸斷處，過江時。
units.en: Where hearts break—when the river is crossed.
units.literal: Where the bowels break—when crossing the river.

units.zh: 銀濤千萬疊，不知何處是瑤池。
units.en: Silver waves fold upon fold—who knows where Jasper Pool lies?
units.literal: Silver waves a thousand thousand layers—knowing not where lies Jasper Pool.

units.zh: 《六州》
units.en: Six Prefectures
units.literal: 《Six Prefectures》

units.zh: 中興運，孝治格升平。
units.en: Restoration fortune—filial rule brings rising peace.
units.literal: Restoration fortune; filial governance attains rising peace.

units.zh: 回騩馭。
units.en: Returning the dark team.
units.literal: Returning the dark team.

units.zh: 弭鳳駕，冊寶初上鴻名。
units.en: The phoenix carriage halts—seals and regalia first raise the vast honored name.
units.literal: Halting the phoenix carriage; seals and regalia first ascend the vast name.

units.zh: 龍樓問寢候雞鳴，更翻來戲彩衣輕。
units.en: At the dragon tower, asking after her rest, waiting for the cock's crow—again and again returning to play, motley dress fluttering light.
units.literal: At the dragon tower asking after sleep, waiting for the cock's crow; again and again turning back to play, colorful dress light.

units.zh: 坤躔夜照老人星，金觴上壽，長願燕慈寧。
units.en: At night the Kun quarter shines on the Old Man star—a golden goblet raises long life; forever wishing peace and joy.
units.literal: The Kun quarter at night illuminates the Old Man star; golden goblet raising long life; forever wishing joyful serenity.

units.zh: 乘雲何處去！
units.en: Where has she gone, riding the clouds!
units.literal: Riding the clouds—where does she go!

units.zh: 愁斷紫簫聲。
units.en: Grief shatters the purple flute's song.
units.literal: Sorrow breaks the purple flute's sound.

units.zh: 追思金殿，椒壁丹楹。
units.en: Recollecting the golden hall—pepper-scented walls and cinnabar pillars.
units.literal: Recollecting the golden hall; pepper walls and cinnabar pillars.

units.zh: 又誰知勤儉仁明，風行化被宮庭。
units.en: Who knew her diligence and frugality, benevolence and clarity—her transforming wind covering the palace halls.
units.literal: Again who knew diligence, frugality, benevolence, and clarity; the wind of transformation covered the palace court.

units.zh: 佑聖主，底明時，陰功暗及生靈。
units.en: She aided the sage sovereign, brought the bright age—hidden merit reaching the people.
units.literal: Aiding the sage lord; arriving at the bright age; yin merit secretly reaching the living souls.

units.zh: 離宮晚，花卉娉婷。
units.en: The detached palace at evening—flowers graceful and fair.
units.literal: Departure palace at evening; flowers and plants graceful and fair.

units.zh: 甲觀高，潮海崢嶸。
units.en: The First Watchtower rises high—tide and sea tower stern.
units.literal: The First Watchtower high; tide and sea towering.

units.zh: 往事回頭，忽飄零。
units.en: Past matters turn back—and suddenly scatter away.
units.literal: Past matters turn the head—suddenly scattered and fallen.

units.zh: 空留嬪禦，掩泣望霓旌。
units.en: Palace ladies remain behind, covering their faces in tears, gazing after the rainbow banners.
units.literal: Empty leaving palace ladies attending; covering faces weeping, gazing at the rainbow banners.

units.zh: 會稽山翠，永祐陵高，而今便是蓬、瀛。
units.en: Mount Kuaiji stands green, Yongyou Mausoleum rises high—now they are Penglai and Yingzhou themselves.
units.literal: Mount Kuaiji green, Yongyou Mausoleum high—now it is Penglai and Yingzhou.

units.zh: 《十二時》
units.en: Twelve Hours
units.literal: 《Twelve Hours》

units.zh: 炎圖景運正延鴻，文思坐深宮。
units.en: The bright dynasty's auspicious fortune spreads in glory; the sovereign's thoughts dwell in the inner palace.
units.literal: The bright dynasty's auspicious fortune extends vast glory; literary thought sits in the deep palace.

units.zh: 慈寧大養，樂事時奏宸聰。
units.en: In Cining Palace she was richly cared for; joyous tidings from time to time reached the imperial ear.
units.literal: Cining's great nurturing; joyous affairs at times present to the imperial ear.

units.zh: 皇齡永，恩霈下遍寰中。
units.en: Her imperial years seemed endless—grace showered throughout the realm.
units.literal: Imperial years everlasting; grace showering down throughout all within the realm.

units.zh: 君王垂彩服，嬪禦上瑤鍾。
units.en: The sovereign wore festive robes; palace ladies struck jade chimes.
units.literal: The king lord wearing motley robes; palace ladies striking jade bells.

units.zh: 年年誕節，就盈吉月，交慶流虹。
units.en: Year after year on her birthday, in the full auspicious month, celebrations crossed like a flowing rainbow.
units.literal: Year after year birth observance; at the full auspicious month; interchanging celebration, flowing rainbow.

units.zh: 歡洽意方濃，不覺仙遊渺邈，但號泣蒼穹。
units.en: Joy had just reached its height—then, unaware, she was far on her immortal journey; only wails rose to the heavens.
units.literal: Joy and harmony intent just thick—unaware the immortal journey distant and far; only wailing to the azure vault.

units.zh: 追慕念音容，詩書慈儉，配古追蹤。
units.en: We remember her voice and face—her learning, kindness, and frugality, worthy of the ancients.
units.literal: Pursuing remembrance, recalling voice and countenance; poetry, books, kindness, and frugality—matching antiquity in following traces.

units.zh: 躬行四德，誰知繼《二南》風。
units.en: She embodied the four virtues in her own conduct—who could have known she would carry on the spirit of the Two Souths?
units.literal: Personally practicing the four virtues—who knew she would continue the wind of the "Two Souths"?

units.zh: 移眄俄空，寶鑒脂澤塵封。
units.en: A turn of the eye—and all was empty; her mirror and cosmetics lay sealed in dust.
units.literal: A turning glance—suddenly empty; precious mirror, rouge and ointment sealed in dust.

units.zh: 清都遠，帝鄉遙，杳難通。
units.en: The Pure Capital is far, the emperor's home remote—lost beyond reach.
units.literal: The Pure Capital far; the emperor's home remote—dim and hard to reach.

units.zh: 想雲軿還上瀛、蓬。
units.en: One imagines the cloud carriage ascending once more to Yingzhou and Penglai.
units.literal: Thinking of the cloud carriage ascending again to Ying and Peng.

units.zh: 稽山何在？
units.en: Where is Mount Kuaiji?
units.literal: Where is Mount Kuaiji?

units.zh: 當年禹宅，萬古蔥蔥。
units.en: Once the home of Yu—green through the ages.
units.literal: In those years Yu's dwelling—ten thousand ages verdant and lush.

units.zh: 最難堪，潮頭定，海波融。
units.en: Most unbearable—the tide stands still, the sea waves melt away.
units.literal: Most unbearable—the tide crest settles, sea waves melt.

units.zh: 顯仁皇后神主祔太廟《導引》一首
units.en: One Processional for enshrining Empress Xianren's spirit tablet in the Grand Ancestral Temple.
units.literal: One piece of 《Processional》 for enshrining Empress Xianren's spirit tablet in the Grand Ancestral Temple.

units.zh: 返虞長樂，猶是億賓天，何事駕仙軿。
units.en: Soul-chasing rites return at Everlasting Joy—she had been heaven's honored guest for ages; why must she mount the immortal carriage?
units.literal: Returning for soul-chasing at Everlasting Joy—still it was a hundred million guesting of heaven; why ride the immortal carriage?

units.zh: 簫笳儀衛辭宮闕，移仗入雲煙。
units.en: Flutes and pipes, the ceremonial guard leave the palace towers—insignia pass into cloud and mist.
units.literal: Flutes and pipes, ceremonial guard, leaving the palace gate-towers; moving insignia into cloud and mist.

units.zh: 於皇清廟敞華筵，昭穆謹承先。
units.en: O, the august temple opens its splendid feast—ancestral ranks receive the forebears with care.
units.literal: O, the august pure temple opens a splendid banquet; zhao and mu carefully receive the forebears.

units.zh: 千秋長奉烝嚐孝，永享中興年。
units.en: For a thousand years may filial offerings be served—forever enjoying the years of restoration.
units.literal: A thousand autumns long serving the seasonal and tasted filial rites; forever enjoying the restoration years.

units.zh: 欽宗皇帝《導引》一首
units.en: One Processional for Emperor Qinzong.
units.literal: One piece of 《Processional》 for Emperor Qinzong.

units.zh: 鼎湖龍遠，九祭畢嘉觴，遙望白雲鄉。
units.en: The dragon of Ding Lake is far off—nine sacrifices done, fine wine raised, gazing toward the white cloud homeland.
units.literal: Ding Lake's dragon far away; nine sacrifices completed, fine goblets raised—gazing distantly toward the white cloud homeland.

units.zh: 簫笳淒咽離天闕，千仗儼成行。
units.en: Flutes and pipes wail as they leave the heavenly gates—a thousand halberds stand in solemn ranks.
units.literal: Flutes and pipes mournfully choked, leaving the heaven gate-tower; a thousand halberds solemn in ordered rows.

units.zh: 聖神昭穆盛重光，寶室萬年藏。
units.en: Sage and divine, ancestral ranks shine with redoubled glory—the treasure vault keeps them for ten thousand years.
units.literal: Sage and divine, zhao and mu flourish in doubled radiance; treasure chamber for ten thousand years' keeping.

units.zh: 皇心追慕思無極，孝饗奉烝嚐。
units.en: The imperial heart's remembrance knows no bound—filial feasts offer the seasonal sacrifices.
units.literal: The imperial heart's remembrance and thought without limit; filial feasts offer the seasonal and tasted offerings.

units.zh: 安穆皇后《導引》一首
units.en: One Processional for Empress Anmu.
units.literal: One piece of 《Processional》 for Empress Anmu.

units.zh: 鳳簫聲斷，縹緲溯丹丘，猶是憶河洲。
units.en: The phoenix flute falls silent—dimly tracing back to the cinnabar hill, still remembering the river isle.
units.literal: Phoenix flute's sound cut off; dim and far, tracing back to the cinnabar hill—still remembering the river isle.

units.zh: 熒煌寶冊來天上，何處訪仙遊？
units.en: Glittering regalia descends from heaven—where can one seek her immortal path?
units.literal: Glittering precious registers come from heaven—where to seek the immortal's journey?

units.zh: 蔥蔥鬱鬱瑞光浮，嘉酌侑芳羞。
units.en: Verdant and lush, auspicious light rises—fine wine accompanies fragrant offerings.
units.literal: Verdant and lush, auspicious light floats; fine libations assist the fragrant offerings.

units.zh: 周輿繡幰歸新廟，百世與千秋。
units.en: The imperial carriage with embroidered curtains returns to the new temple—for a hundred generations, a thousand years.
units.literal: Zhou carriage with embroidered curtains returns to the new temple—a hundred generations and a thousand autumns.

units.zh: 景靈宮奉安神禦三首
units.en: Three pieces: installing the sacred spirit at Jingling Palace.
units.literal: Three pieces for installing the sacred spirit at Jingling Palace.

units.zh: 徽宗皇帝《導引》
units.en: Processional for Emperor Huizong.
units.literal: 《Processional》 for Emperor Huizong.

units.zh: 中興復古，孝治日昭鴻，原廟飾瑰宮。
units.en: The restoration revived antiquity—filial rule daily shines in glory; the ancestral temple adorned a palace of jade.
units.literal: Restoration restores antiquity; filial governance daily manifests vast glory; the original temple adorns a jade-like palace.

units.zh: 金璧千門磻萬磶，楹桷競穹崇。
units.en: Gold and jade, a thousand gates, myriad stone steps—pillars and rafters rise to compete with the sky.
units.literal: Gold and jade, a thousand gates, myriad stone steps; pillars and rafters vying in vault-like loftiness.

units.zh: 亭童芝蓋擁旌龍，列聖儼相從。
units.en: Canopy bearers and auspicious parasols escort dragon banners—ranked sages solemnly follow.
units.literal: Canopy attendants and mushroom caps escort bannered dragons; ranked sages solemnly follow in company.

units.zh: 共錫神孫千萬壽，龜鼎亙衡、嵩。
units.en: Together they grant the divine descendant endless years—tortoise and cauldron spanning Mount Heng and Mount Song.
units.literal: Together bestowing the divine descendant ten thousand myriad years—tortoise and cauldron spanning Heng and Song.

units.zh: 顯仁皇后《導引》
units.en: Processional for Empress Xianren.
units.literal: 《Processional》 for Empress Xianren.

units.zh: 坤儀厚載，遺德滿寰中，歸禦廣寒宮。
units.en: Earth's bearing, her legacy virtue filled the realm—she returns to ride in the Broad Cold Palace.
units.literal: Earth's bearing with thick loads; legacy virtue fills all within the realm—returning to ride the Broad Cold Palace.

units.zh: 玉容如在飆輿遠，長樂起悲風。
units.en: Her jade face seems still present—yet the spirit carriage is far; mournful winds rise at Everlasting Joy.
units.literal: Jade countenance as if still present—the wind carriage far away; Everlasting Joy rises with mournful wind.

units.zh: 霓旌絳節下層空，雲闕曉曈。
units.en: Rainbow banners and crimson streamers descend from the heavens—the cloud palace brightens at dawn.
units.literal: Rainbow banners and crimson streamers descend from layered heaven; cloud gate-tower, dawn bright.

units.zh: 真遊千載安原廟，聖孝與天通。
units.en: A thousand years may her spirit rest in the ancestral temple—sage filial piety reaching heaven itself.
units.literal: True journey—a thousand years at peace in the original temple; sage filial piety connects with heaven.

units.zh: 欽宗皇帝《導引》
units.en: Processional for Emperor Qinzong.
units.literal: 《Processional》 for Emperor Qinzong.

units.zh: 深仁厚德，流澤自無窮，仙馭倏賓空。
units.en: Deep benevolence, thick virtue—grace flowing without end; the immortal steeds suddenly depart to the empty sky.
units.literal: Deep benevolence, thick virtue—flowing grace without end; immortal team suddenly guesting the empty sky.

units.zh: 衣冠未返蒼梧遠，遙望鼎湖龍。
units.en: Robes and caps not yet returned—Cangwu far away; gazing distantly at the dragon of Ding Lake.
units.literal: Robes and caps not yet returned—Cangwu far away; gazing distantly at Ding Lake's dragon.

units.zh: 人間仿佛認天容，縹緲五雲中。
units.en: In the human realm one seems to know heaven's face—dim within five-colored clouds.
units.literal: In the human realm, as if recognizing heaven's countenance—dim within five-colored clouds.

units.zh: 帝城猶有遺民在，垂淚向西風。
units.en: In the imperial city people still remain—shedding tears into the west wind.
units.literal: The imperial city still has remnant people remaining; shedding tears toward the west wind.

units.zh: 安恭皇后上仙發引一首
units.en: One piece: Empress Angong's ascent to immortality and the funeral procession's departure.
units.literal: One piece for Empress Angong's ascent to immortality and the departure of the funeral procession.

units.zh: 金殿晚，愁結坤寧。
units.en: The golden hall at evening—sorrow knots Kunning Palace.
units.literal: Golden hall at evening; sorrow knots Kunning.

units.zh: 天下母，忽仙升。
