units.en: Mother of the realm—suddenly ascends to immortality.
units.literal: Mother of all under heaven—suddenly ascends as immortal.

units.zh: 雲山浩浩歸何處？
units.en: Clouds and mountains stretch vast—where has she gone?
units.literal: Clouds and mountains vast and wide—returning where?

units.zh: 但聞空際彩鸞聲。
units.en: Only the colored phoenix is heard crying in the empty sky.
units.literal: Only hearing in the empty sky the colored phoenix's cry.

units.zh: 紫簫斷後無蹤跡，煙靄夜澄澄。
units.en: After the purple flute falls silent—no trace remains; mist and night are clear and still.
units.literal: After the purple flute is cut off—no trace remains; mist and haze, night clear and pure.

units.zh: 曉夢到瑤城，當時花木正冥冥。
units.en: At dawn one dreams of Jasper City—then flowers and trees were dim in the gloom.
units.literal: At dawn, dreaming of Jasper City—at that time flowers and trees just dim and dark.

units.zh: 高宗梓宮發引三首
units.en: Three pieces: the departure of Emperor Gaozong's funeral procession.
units.literal: Three pieces for the departure of the funeral procession of Emperor Gaozong's coffin.

units.zh: 《導引》
units.en: Processional
units.literal: 《Processional》

units.zh: 寒日短，草露朝晞。
units.en: The cold sun is brief—grass dew dries by morning.
units.literal: Cold sun short; grass dew dried by morning.

units.zh: 仙鶴下，夢雲歸。
units.en: The immortal crane descends—dream clouds return.
units.literal: Immortal crane descends; dream clouds return.

units.zh: 大椿亭畔蒼蒼柳，悵無由挽住天衣。
units.en: Dark willows beside Great Cinquefoil Pavilion—regret, with no way to hold back heaven's robes.
units.literal: Beside Great Cinquefoil Pavilion, dark green willows—regret without means to hold back heaven's robes.

units.zh: 昭陽深，暝鴉飛。
units.en: Deep within Zhaoyang Palace—dusk crows fly.
units.literal: Zhaoyang deep; dusk crows fly.

units.zh: 愁帶箭，戀恩棲。
units.en: Sorrow pierced like by an arrow—lingering from love of grace.
units.literal: Sorrow pierced by arrow; attached to grace, roosting.

units.zh: 笳簫三疊奏，都人悲淚袂成帷。
units.en: Flutes and pipes play three stanzas—the capital's people weep till sleeves become curtains.
units.literal: Flutes and pipes, three-fold performance; capital people, sorrowful tears—sleeves become curtains.

units.zh: 《六州》
units.en: Six Prefectures
units.literal: 《Six Prefectures》

units.zh: 堯傳舜，盛事千古難並。
units.en: Yao passed the throne to Shun—a grand event unmatched through the ages.
units.literal: Yao passed to Shun—a grand event hard to match through a thousand ages.

units.zh: 回龍馭，辭鳳掖，北內別有蓬、瀛。
units.en: The dragon team returns, the phoenix chamber is left—the Northern Inner Palace holds its own Penglai and Yingzhou.
units.literal: Returning the dragon team; leaving the phoenix side-chamber—within the Northern Inner Palace, separately there is Peng and Ying.

units.zh: 為天子父，冊鴻名，萬年千歲福康寧，春秋不說楚冥靈。
units.en: As the emperor's father, honored with a magnificent title—for ten thousand years, may he enjoy fortune, health, and peace; let none speak of Chu's long-lived Mingling tree.
units.literal: As the Son of Heaven's father, he is registered under a magnificent name—for ten thousand years, a thousand years of fortune, peace, and ease; speak no more of Chu's long-lived Mingling tree.

units.zh: 萊衣彩戲，漢殿玉卮輕，宸遊今不見，煙外落霞明。
units.en: Motley dress and joyful play—jade goblets in the Han halls; imperial outings are seen no more—beyond the mist, sunset glows.
units.literal: Garden-joy motley play; Han hall jade goblet light; imperial outings now unseen—beyond mist, setting sun bright.

units.zh: 前回丁未，霧塞神京。
units.en: Before, in the dingwei year—fog blocked the divine capital.
units.literal: The previous time, in the dingwei year—fog blocked the divine capital.

units.zh: 正同符光武中興，擎天獨力扶傾。
units.en: Just like Guangwu's restoration—alone he held up heaven and righted the leaning realm.
units.literal: Just matching the tally of Guangwu's restoration—holding up heaven, alone with strength righting the leaning.

units.zh: 定宗廟，保河山，乾坤整頓庚庚。
units.en: He fixed the ancestral temple, guarded rivers and mountains—the cosmos set in bright order.
units.literal: Set the ancestral temple, protect rivers and mountains—the universe set in order, bright and clear.

units.zh: 功成了，脫屣遺榮。
units.en: Merit complete—he shed his shoes and left glory behind.
units.literal: Merit accomplished—shedding shoes, leaving glory behind.

units.zh: 訪崆峒，容與丹庭。
units.en: He visited Kongtong, wandered at ease in the cinnabar court.
units.literal: Visiting Kongtong; leisurely roaming the cinnabar court.

units.zh: 笑挹塵寰，不留行。
units.en: Smiling he lifted a cup to the dusty world—and would not stay.
units.literal: Laughing, scooping the dusty realm—not staying behind.

units.zh: 吾皇哀戀，淚血灑神旌。
units.en: Our emperor, mourning in love—tears and blood sprinkled on the spirit banners.
units.literal: Our emperor's mournful attachment—tears and blood sprinkled on the spirit banners.

units.zh: 腸斷濤江渡，明日稽山，暮雲東望元陵。
units.en: Hearts break at the Ta River crossing—tomorrow Mount Kuaiji; at dusk, eastward gazing toward the primal tomb.
units.literal: Bowels broken at Taojiang crossing; tomorrow Mount Kuaiji—dusk clouds, eastward gazing at the primal mausoleum.

units.zh: 《十二時》
units.en: Twelve Hours
units.literal: 《Twelve Hours》

units.zh: 璧門雙闕轉蒼龍，德壽儼祗宮。
units.en: Jade gates and paired towers turn with the dark dragon—Deshou Palace stands in reverent service.
units.literal: Jade gate's paired towers turn with the dark dragon; Deshou reverently serves the palace.

units.zh: 軒屏正坐，天子親拜天公，儀紳笏，羅鵷鷺，粲庭中。
units.en: At the center screen the Son of Heaven sits upright, bowing personally to the Lord of Heaven—sashes and tablets in order, egrets and cranes arrayed, brilliant in the hall.
units.literal: At the center screen sitting upright, the Son of Heaven personally bows to the Lord of Heaven; ceremonial sashes and tablets, rows of egrets and cranes, brilliant in the court.

units.zh: 仙家歡不盡，人世壽無窮。
units.en: Immortal joy seemed endless—human longevity without bound.
units.literal: Immortal realm joy without end; human world's longevity without bound.

units.zh: 誰知雲路，玉京成就，催返璿穹，轉手萬緣空。
units.en: Who knew that once the Jade Capital was reached on the cloud path, heaven would summon him back—in a turning of the hand all worldly ties were void.
units.literal: Who knew the cloud path, the Jade Capital achieved, would urge return to the starry vault—in a turning of the hand all causes become empty.

units.zh: 見說煙霄好處，不與下方同。
units.en: They say the misty heights are fine—unlike anything below.
units.literal: It is said the misty heights' fine places are not the same as below.

units.zh: 塵合霧迷濛，笙簫寥亮，樓閣玲瓏。
units.en: Dust gathers, mist blurs—flutes and pipes sound sparse and clear, towers and pavilions gleam exquisite.
units.literal: Dust gathers, mist blurs and hazes; flutes and pipes sparse and clear, towers and pavilions exquisite.

units.zh: 中興大業，巍巍稽古成功。
units.en: The restoration's great enterprise—towering success, modeled on antiquity.
units.literal: Restoration great enterprise—towering, examining antiquity, success.

units.zh: 事去孤鴻，忍聽宵柝晨鍾！
units.en: All is gone like a lone wild goose—who can bear the night watch and morning bell!
units.literal: Affairs gone—a lone goose; hard to bear the night watch and morning bell!

units.zh: 靈轝駕，素幃低，杳厖茸。
units.en: The spirit carriage moves, white curtains hang low—dim and hazy.
units.literal: Spirit carriage rides; white curtains low—dim and hazy.

units.zh: 浙江潮，萬神護，川後滋恭。
units.en: The Zhe River tide—ten thousand spirits guard; the river lord grows ever more reverent.
units.literal: Zhe River tide—ten thousand spirits guard; the river lord ever more reverent.

units.zh: 因山祗事，崔嵬禹穴，此日重逢。
units.en: Mountain rites reverently performed—lofty Yu's cavern; on this day we meet again.
units.literal: Mountain rites reverently performed; lofty and steep Yu's cavern—this day once again meet.

units.zh: 柏城封，愁長夜，起悲風。
units.en: The cypress city is sealed—sorrow through the long night, mournful winds rise.
units.literal: Cypress city sealed; sorrow long night, rising mournful wind.

units.zh: 歌《清廟》，千古誦高宗。
units.en: They sing the Pure Temple ode—for a thousand years Gaozong will be praised.
units.literal: Singing the 《Pure Temple》—through a thousand years chanting Gaozong.

units.zh: 虞主赴德壽宮《導引》一首
units.en: One Processional for the soul tablet's journey to Deshou Palace.
units.literal: One piece of 《Processional》 for the soul tablet's journey to Deshou Palace.

units.zh: 上皇天大，華旦煥堯文，鴻福浩無垠，羽龍俄駕靈盾去，空鎖鼎湖雲。
units.en: The retired emperor vast as heaven—glorious dawn restored Yao's ways, fortune boundless; the feathered dragon soon bore the spirit bier away, leaving only Ding Lake's clouds locked empty.
units.literal: The retired emperor vast as heaven; glorious dawn restores Yao's ways; grand fortune vast without bound; feathered dragon soon drives the spirit shield away, empty locking Ding Lake's clouds.

units.zh: 稽山翠擁浙江濆，歸旆卷繽紛。
units.en: Mount Kuaiji's green embraces the Zhe River's banks—returning banners roll in splendid array.
units.literal: Mount Kuaiji green embraces Zhe River's banks; returning banners roll in splendid array.

units.zh: 仙遊指日嚴升祔，萬載頌高勳。
units.en: The immortal journey soon leads to solemn temple installation—high merit praised for ten thousand years.
units.literal: Immortal journey the day draws near for solemn temple installation; ten thousand years praising high merit.

units.zh: 祔廟《導引》一首
units.en: One Processional for temple installation.
units.literal: One piece of 《Processional》 for temple installation.

units.zh: 虞觴奉主，仙馭返皇宮，禮典極欽崇。
units.en: Soul-chasing libation presents the lord; the immortal carriage returns to the imperial palace, the rites held in utmost reverence.
units.literal: Soul-chasing libation presenting the lord; the immortal carriage returns to the imperial palace; ritual codes utmost reverence and honor.

units.zh: 雲旗前導開清廟，龍管咽薰風。
units.en: Cloud banners lead the way, opening the pure temple—dragon pipes wail in fragrant wind.
units.literal: Cloud banners forward escort opening the pure temple; dragon pipes choked in fragrant wind.

units.zh: 巍巍堯父告神功，追慕孝誠通。
units.en: Towering as Yao's father, divine merit is proclaimed—remembrance and filial sincerity reach through.
units.literal: Towering Yao's father declares divine merit; pursuing remembrance, filial sincerity penetrating.

units.zh: 千秋萬歲中興統，宗祀與天同。
units.en: For a thousand years, ten thousand years—the restoration line; ancestral sacrifice is one with heaven.
units.literal: A thousand autumns, ten thousand years—the restoration line; ancestral sacrifice one with heaven.

units.zh: 淳熙十六年高宗神禦奉安《導引》一首
units.en: Chunxi year 16: one Processional for installing Emperor Gaozong's sacred spirit.
units.literal: Chunxi year 16: one piece of 《Processional》 for installing Emperor Gaozong's sacred spirit.

units.zh: 中興揖遜，功德仰兼隆，仁澤被華戎。
units.en: Restoration through abdication—merit and virtue revered in equal loftiness; benevolent grace reaching China and all beyond.
units.literal: Restoration abdication; merit and virtue looked up to, both lofty; benevolent grace covering China and the barbarians.

units.zh: 鼎湖俄痛遺弓墮，如日想威容。
units.en: At Ding Lake grief strikes suddenly—the bow has fallen; as at the sun, we yearn for his majestic face.
units.literal: At Ding Lake, sudden grief—the fallen bow; like the sun, thinking of majestic countenance.

units.zh: 柔儀懿範與堯同，飆馭儼相從。
units.en: Gentle bearing and worthy example matched Yao's; the whirlwind escort solemnly follows in train.
units.literal: Gentle mien, worthy model same as Yao; whirlwind escort solemnly follows along.

units.zh: 靈宮真館偕來燕，垂裕永無窮。
units.en: Spirit palaces and true halls receive him in peace; blessings handed down without end.
units.literal: Spirit palaces and true halls together come in peace; handed-down abundance without end forever.

units.zh: 紹熙五年孝宗皇帝虞主還宮《導引》一首
units.en: Shaoxi year 5: one Processional for Emperor Xiaozong's soul tablet return to the palace.
units.literal: Shaoxi year 5: one piece of 《Processional》 for Emperor Xiaozong's soul tablet return to the palace.

units.zh: 孝宗純孝，前聖更何加！
units.en: Xiaozong's filial piety was pure—what could former sages have added!
units.literal: Xiaozong pure filial piety—what could the former sages add!

units.zh: 高蹈處重華。
units.en: He walked on high, dwelling at Chonghua.
units.literal: High treading, dwelling at Chonghua.

units.zh: 丹成仙去龍盾遠，越岸暮山遐。
units.en: The perfected sage ascends—the dragon bier far away; Yue's shores and evening mountains stretch distant.
units.literal: Cinnabar perfected, immortal gone—dragon shield far; Yue shore, evening mountains distant.

units.zh: 波臣先為卷寒沙，來往護靈槎。
units.en: The waves first roll back the cold sand—coming and going they escort the spirit raft.
units.literal: Wave subjects first roll back the cold sand; coming and going escort the spirit raft.

units.zh: 九虞禮舉神祗樂，萬世佑皇家。
units.en: Nine lament rites are performed—spirits and gods rejoice; the royal house is blessed for ten thousand generations.
units.literal: Nine lament rites performed—spirits and gods rejoice; ten thousand generations protecting the imperial house.

units.zh: 祔廟《導引》一首
units.en: One Processional for temple installation.
units.literal: One piece of 《Processional》 for temple installation.

units.zh: 吾皇盡孝，宗廟務崇尊，钜典備彌文。
units.en: Our emperor's filial piety knows no limit—the ancestral temple held in highest reverence; grand rites fully prepared in splendid detail.
units.literal: Our emperor exhausts filial piety; ancestral temple strives for honored reverence; grand rites fully prepared, text abundant.

units.zh: 巍巍東向開基主，七世祔神孫。
units.en: Towering—the east-facing founding lord, seven generations of spirit grandsons enshrined.
units.literal: Towering, the east-facing founding lord; seven generations with spirit grandsons enshrined.

units.zh: 追思九閏整乾坤，寰宇慕洪恩。
units.en: Recalling nine intercalary years that ordered Heaven and Earth—the realm admires vast favor.
units.literal: Recollecting nine intercalary years ordering Heaven and Earth; all within the seas admires vast favor.

units.zh: 從今密邇高宗室，千載事如存。
units.en: From now placed close beside Gaozong's hall—a thousand years' deeds as though still present.
units.literal: From now close beside Gaozong's hall; a thousand years' affairs as if still present.

units.zh: 慶元六年光宗皇帝發引一首
units.en: Qingyuan year 6: one piece for Emperor Guangzong's funeral procession departure.
units.literal: Qingyuan year 6: one piece for the departure of Emperor Guangzong's funeral procession.

units.zh: 笳鼓發，雲慘寒空。
units.en: Reed horns and drums sound forth—clouds bleak in the cold sky.
units.literal: Reed horns and drums sound forth; clouds bleak, cold sky.

units.zh: 丹去，卷悲風。
units.en: The sage ascends; sorrowful wind rolls on.
units.literal: Cinnabar gone, rolling sorrowful wind.

units.zh: 憂勤六載親幾務，有巍巍聖德仁功。
units.en: Six years of anxious toil handling affairs in person—towering sacred virtue and benevolent achievement.
units.literal: Six years anxious toil handling affairs in person—there was towering sacred virtue and benevolent achievement.

units.zh: 褰裳尊處大安宮，荊鼎就，遽遺弓。
units.en: Robes lifted in honor at the Great Peace Palace—the jing tripod cast, and suddenly the bow is left behind.
units.literal: Lifting robes, honoring at the Great Peace Palace; the jing tripod cast—suddenly the bow is left behind.

units.zh: 仙遊攀不及，臣民號慟訴蒼穹。
units.en: The immortal journey—none can climb to reach him; officials and people cry and lament to heaven.
units.literal: Immortal journey—climbing to reach not; officials and people cry and lament to the azure vault.

units.zh: 神禦奉安一首
units.en: One piece: installing the sacred spirit.
units.literal: One piece for installing the sacred spirit.

units.zh: 《導引》
units.en: Processional
units.literal: 《Processional》

units.zh: 龜書畀姒，曆數在皇躬，揖遜仰高風。
units.en: The tortoise book bestowed on Si—the tally of succession in the emperor's hands; abdication yielding, looking up to lofty virtue.
units.literal: Tortoise book bestowed on Si; the tally of succession on the emperor's person; yielding abdication, looking up to lofty wind.

units.zh: 鼎湖龍去遺弓墮，冠劍鎖深宮。
units.en: The Ding Lake dragon is gone—the bow fallen; crown and sword locked in the deep palace.
units.literal: Ding Lake dragon gone—the fallen bow; crown and sword locked in the deep palace.

units.zh: 塗山齊德翊成功，仙魄蚤賓空。
units.en: At Mount Tu, virtue matched to aid success—the spirit soul departed early, leaving emptiness.
units.literal: Mount Tu equal in virtue aiding success; spirit soul early guest, empty.

units.zh: 珍台閑館棲神地，獻饗永無窮。
units.en: Rare terrace and quiet hall—the spirit's dwelling; offerings presented forever without end.
units.literal: Rare terrace and idle hall—the spirit's dwelling; offerings presented forever without end.

units.zh: 寧宗皇帝發引三首
units.en: Three pieces: Emperor Ningzong's funeral procession departure.
units.literal: Three pieces for the departure of Emperor Ningzong's funeral procession.

units.zh: 《導引》
units.en: Processional
units.literal: 《Processional》

units.zh: 三弄曉，雲黯天低。
units.en: Three stanzas at dawn—clouds darken, the sky hangs low.
units.literal: Three stanzas at dawn; clouds dark, sky low.

units.zh: 攀六引，轉悲淒。
units.en: Climbing the Six Prefectures' lament—growing ever more mournful and desolate.
units.literal: Climbing the Six Prefectures' lament—turning ever more mournful and desolate.

units.zh: 儉慈孝哲鍾天性，深仁厚澤遍群黎。
units.en: Frugal, benevolent, wise, and sagacious by nature—deep kindness and ample grace reaching all the people.
units.literal: Frugal, benevolent, wise, and sagacious—nature's gift; deep kindness and thick grace throughout the multitudes.

units.zh: 東西南北傒商霓。
units.en: East, west, south, north—all await the merchant rainbow.
units.literal: East, west, south, north—waiting for the merchant rainbow.

units.zh: 功甫就，別宸閨。
units.en: Merit just achieved—parting from the imperial chambers.
units.literal: Merit just achieved; parting from the imperial boudoir.

units.zh: 臣民千古恨，幾時羽衛帶潮歸！
units.en: Officials and people grieve for a thousand ages—when will the feathered guards return with the tide!
units.literal: Officials and people, grief through a thousand ages—when will feathered guards return with the tide!

units.zh: 《六州》
units.en: Six Prefectures
units.literal: 《Six Prefectures》

units.zh: 明天子，昔日丕纂鴻圖。
units.en: The bright Son of Heaven—once grandly inherited the vast design.
units.literal: Bright Son of Heaven—in former days grandly inherited the vast design.

units.zh: 躬道德，崇學問，稽古訓，訪群儒。
units.en: He personally cultivated virtue, esteemed learning, examined ancient teachings, and visited the learned.
units.literal: Personally cultivating virtue; esteeming learning; examining ancient instructions; visiting the scholar-multitude.

units.zh: 日親廣廈論唐、虞，講求政治想都俞，君臣一德誌交孚。
units.en: Daily in the broad hall he discussed Tang and Yu—seeking good governance, thinking of that ancient harmony; ruler and ministers one in virtue, mutual trust fulfilled.
units.literal: Daily in the broad hall discussing Tang and Yu; seeking good governance, thinking of the 'du-yu' assent; ruler and ministers one in virtue, aspirations mutually trusting.

units.zh: 外夷效順，猶自選車徒。
units.en: Outer tribes showed obedience—yet he still personally selected chariot troops.
units.literal: Outer barbarians showing obedience—still he personally selected chariot troops.

units.zh: 仁恩沾四國，固結滿寰區。
units.en: Benevolent grace soaked the four states—solid bonds filled the whole realm.
units.literal: Benevolent grace soaked the four states; solid bonds filled the whole realm.

units.zh: 千年宗社，萬歲規摹。
units.en: A thousand years for the ancestral temple; ten thousand years for plan and model.
units.literal: A thousand years' ancestral temple; ten thousand years' plan and model.

units.zh: 重新天命出乾符，老癃策杖相扶，願觀德化遍方隅。
units.en: Anew Heaven's mandate issued the Qian tally—the old and feeble lean on staffs and support each other, wishing to see virtuous transformation everywhere.
units.literal: Anew Heaven's mandate issued the Qian tally; old and feeble, leaning on staffs, mutually supporting—wishing to see virtuous transformation everywhere.

units.zh: 幸無死須臾，謂宜聖壽等嵩呼。
units.en: Fortunate not to die in a moment—we thought his sacred longevity would match Mount Song's acclamation.
units.literal: Fortunate not to die in a moment—we thought sacred longevity would equal Song's acclamation.

units.zh: 遽登雲輿上龍湖，宸居幽寂紫雲孤。
units.en: Suddenly he ascended cloud carriage to Dragon Lake—the imperial residence lonely under solitary purple clouds.
units.literal: Suddenly ascending cloud carriage to Dragon Lake; imperial residence lonely, purple clouds solitary.

units.zh: 宸章寶畫，但與日星俱。
units.en: Imperial writings and precious paintings remain only with the sun and stars.
units.literal: Imperial writings and precious paintings—only together with sun and stars.

units.zh: 龍帷鳳翣已載途，忍聽笳鼓嗟籲！
units.en: Dragon curtain and phoenix fan already loaded on the road—how can we bear the reed horns and drums sighing and lamenting!
units.literal: Dragon curtain and phoenix fan already loaded on the road—how bear to hear reed horns and drums sigh and lament!

units.zh: 《十二時》
units.en: Twelve Hours
units.literal: 《Twelve Hours》

units.zh: 弋綈革舄最仁賢，儉德自躬全。
units.en: Hunting cloth and straw sandals—most benevolent and worthy; frugal virtue personally upheld, complete.
units.literal: Hunting cloth and straw sandals most benevolent and worthy; frugal virtue personally practiced, complete.

units.zh: 憂勤庶政，三十餘年。
units.en: Anxious toil over common governance—for thirty-plus years.
units.literal: Anxious toil over common governance; thirty-plus years.

units.zh: 金風肅，秋漸老，攝調愆。
units.en: Golden wind turns stern—autumn grows old; his vital tone falls out of balance.
units.literal: Golden wind stern; autumn gradually aging; vital tone out of balance.

units.zh: 忱恂遍群祀，號泣訴旻天。
units.en: Sincere and earnest at every sacrifice—crying and appealing to heaven.
units.literal: Sincere and earnest throughout all sacrifices; crying and weeping appealing to Heaven.

units.zh: 綴衣將出，神凝玉幾，一夜登仙，弓墮隔蒼煙。
units.en: Final garments about to be laid out—the spirit congealed at the jade frame; one night he ascended to immortality, the bow fallen beyond azure smoke.
units.literal: Final garments about to go out; spirit congealed at the jade frame; one night ascending immortality—the bow fallen, separated by azure smoke.

units.zh: 七月有來同軌，引綍動靈輇。
units.en: In the seventh month mourners come on the same track—pulling the pall moves the spirit carriage.
units.literal: In the seventh month mourners come on the same track; pulling the pall moves the spirit carriage.

units.zh: 淒愴淚潸然，行號巷哭，《薤露》聲傳。
units.en: Desolate, tears stream—walking, wailing in the lanes, Thoroughwort Dew's sound passes on.
units.literal: Desolate, tears streaming; walking, wailing in lanes, 《Thoroughwort Dew》 sound passing.

units.zh: 東城去路，驚濤忍見江船！
units.en: East city departing road—surging waves; how can we bear to see the river boat!
units.literal: East city departing road—surging waves, how bear to see the river boat!

units.zh: 憔悴山川，不禁簫鼓咽。
units.en: Haggard mountains and rivers—reed pipes and drums choke unbearably.
units.literal: Haggard mountains and rivers—cannot bear reed pipes and drums choking.

units.zh: 山陰處，茂林修竹芊芊。
units.en: At Shanyin—luxuriant forests and cultivated bamboo lush.
units.literal: At Shanyin place—luxuriant forests, cultivated bamboo lush.

units.zh: 望陵宮，應弗遠，金粟堆前。
units.en: Gazing at the mausoleum palace—it cannot be far, before the Golden Millet mound.
units.literal: Gazing at the mausoleum palace—surely not far; before the Golden Millet mound.

units.zh: 人徒慕戀，百神警侍，盤翥驅先。
units.en: People yearn and long—the hundred spirits stand alert attending, coiling and hovering to drive ahead.
units.literal: People only yearning and longing; hundred spirits alert attending; coiling and hovering drive ahead.

units.zh: 戴鴻恩，空痛慕，淚珠連。
units.en: Bearing vast favor—empty grief and longing, teardrops linking.
units.literal: Bearing vast favor, empty grief and longing—teardrops linking.

units.zh: 千秋歲，功德寄華編。
units.en: A thousand years—merit and virtue entrusted to splendid annals.
units.literal: A thousand autumns' years; merit and virtue entrusted to splendid annals.

units.zh: 神主祔廟《導引》一首
units.en: One Processional for the soul tablet's temple installation.
units.literal: One piece of 《Processional》 for the soul tablet's temple installation.

units.zh: 中興四葉，休德繼昭清，王度日熙平。
units.en: The restoration's fourth generation—bright virtue succeeding brilliant clarity; royal measures passing in prosperity and peace.
units.literal: Restoration's fourth leaf; bright virtue succeeding to brilliant clarity; royal measures passing in prosperity and peace.

units.zh: 氣調玉燭金穰應，八表頌聲騰。
units.en: Vital essence harmonized—jade candles match, golden harvest answers; praise soars from the eight directions.
units.literal: Vital essence harmonized—jade candles, golden harvest answered; eight directions praising, voices soaring.

units.zh: 中原圖籍入宸廷，列聖慰真靈。
units.en: Central Plain registers and maps enter the imperial court—successive sages comfort the true spirit.
units.literal: Central Plain registers and maps enter the imperial court; successive sages comforting the true spirit.

units.zh: 袞龍登廟遊仙闕，億萬載尊承。
units.en: Brocade dragon ascends the temple, roaming the immortal gate—honored and received for ten thousand myriad loads.
units.literal: Brocade dragon ascending the temple, roaming immortal gate; ten thousand myriad loads honored and received.

units.zh: 寶慶三年奉上寧宗徽號《導引》一首
units.en: Baoqing year 3: one Processional for presenting Emperor Ningzong's posthumous honorific title.
units.literal: Baoqing year 3: one piece of 《Processional》 for presenting Emperor Ningzong's posthumous honorific title.

units.zh: 中興五葉，天子肇明禋，一德格高旻。
units.en: The restoration's fifth generation—the Son of Heaven inaugurates bright sacrifice; one virtue attaining the lofty heavens.
units.literal: Restoration's fifth leaf; Son of Heaven inaugurates bright sacrifice; one virtue attaining the lofty vault.

units.zh: 寧皇至聖功超古，萬國慕深仁。
units.en: Emperor Ning supremely sage—merit surpassing antiquity; ten thousand states admire deep benevolence.
units.literal: Ning Emperor supremely sage—merit surpassing antiquity; ten thousand states admiring deep benevolence.

units.zh: 徽稱顯號又還新，功德粲雕瑉。
units.en: Honorific title and manifest designation renewed again—merit and virtue brilliant, carved in jade.
units.literal: Honorific title and manifest designation again renewed; merit and virtue brilliant, carved in jade.

units.zh: 乾坤繪畫終難盡，遺澤在斯民。
units.en: Heaven and Earth painted—hard to exhaust; remaining grace rests in these people.
units.literal: Heaven and Earth painted—hard to exhaust completely; remaining grace in these people.

units.zh: 莊文太子薨《導引》一首
units.en: One Processional for Crown Prince Zhuangwen's death.
units.literal: One piece of 《Processional》 for Crown Prince Zhuangwen's death.

units.zh: 秋月冷，秋鶴無聲。
units.en: Autumn moon cold—the autumn crane silent.
units.literal: Autumn moon cold; autumn crane without sound.

units.zh: 清禁曉，動皇情。
units.en: Clear forbidden precinct at dawn—stirring imperial feeling.
units.literal: Clear forbidden precinct at dawn; stirring imperial sentiment.

units.zh: 玉笙忽斷今何在？
units.en: The jade flute suddenly falls silent—where is it now?
units.literal: Jade flute suddenly cut off—where is it now?

units.zh: 不知誰報玉樓成。
units.en: Who knows who reports that the Jade Tower is complete.
units.literal: Not knowing who reports the Jade Tower completed.

units.zh: 七星授轡驂鸞種，人不見，恨難平。
units.en: Seven stars bestow reins, luan-breed steeds tri-harnessed—he is seen no more; grief cannot be stilled.
units.literal: Seven stars bestowing reins, tri-horses of the luan breed; person unseen—grief hard to level.

units.zh: 何以返霓旌？
units.en: How shall the rainbow banners return?
units.literal: How return the rainbow banners?

units.zh: 一天風露苦淒清。
units.en: One day's wind and dew—bitter, desolate, and cold.
units.literal: One day's wind and dew—bitter, desolate, and clear.

units.zh: 景獻太子薨《導引》一首
units.en: One Processional for Crown Prince Jingxian's death.
units.literal: One piece of 《Processional》 for Crown Prince Jingxian's death.

units.zh: 霜月苦，宮鼓冬冬。
units.en: Bitter frost moon—palace drums beat on and on.
units.literal: Frost moon bitter; palace drums beat dong dong.

units.zh: 霓啟，鶴闈空。
units.en: Rainbow opens—the crane gate stands empty.
units.literal: Rainbow opens; crane gate empty.

units.zh: 洞簫聲斷知何處，海山依約五雲東。
units.en: The cave flute falls silent—where does it go? Sea mountains lie dimly toward Five Clouds in the east.
units.literal: Cave flute sound cut off—knowing where? Sea mountains dimly approximating Five Clouds East.

units.zh: 玉符龍節參神，昭聖眷，慘天容。
units.en: Jade tally and dragon tally join the spirit—sacred favor displayed, heaven's countenance somber.
units.literal: Jade tally and dragon tally join the spirit; displaying sacred favor; somber heaven's countenance.

units.zh: 千古恨無窮，遍山松柏撼悲風。
units.en: Grief through a thousand ages without end—mountain pines and cypresses shake in sorrowful wind.
units.literal: Grief through a thousand ages without end; mountain pines and cypresses shake sorrowful wind.
